title: Financial Controller
description:
Ikigai Cases is hiring a Controller!

Location: Remote / Work From Home

Reports to: CEO





About the Company

Ikigai Cases (
) is a fast-growing ecommerce brand manufacturing aerospace-grade aluminum pill cases. Founded in December 2021 by two brothers after their father’s neurological diagnosis led them to discovering the issues with plastic pill organizers, we’ve built a multi-million dollar business in just over four years with a team of 25 across the globe.



Our mission is simple: make exceptional pill cases and provide exceptional customer service. We deliver on this by managing in-house fulfillment at our Washington, DC facility (including custom engraving) and maintaining obsessive attention to detail.





About the Role

We are hiring a Controller to take complete ownership of our financial operations - accounting, reporting, payroll, budgeting, cash flow, tax coordination, and financial systems. This is a critical senior role, and we’re looking for someone whose professional identity is built around three things: the integrity of the numbers, running the finance function end-to-end, and providing strategic financial insight to the CEO.



The ideal candidate has served as a Controller (or equivalent) for an e-commerce or DTC brand in the $10–30M revenue range. You understand the financial rhythms of e-commerce: Shopify revenue recognition, inventory accounting, seasonal cash flow swings, sales tax across multiple states, and the speed at which decisions need to be made. If you’ve done this before at a similar-sized company, you already know what we need.



We need someone who builds systems, not just operates inside them. You’ll report directly to the CEO and work hand-in-hand with our external financial advisor. No layers of management between you and the decisions your work supports.





Core Responsibilities

Monthly Close & Financial Reporting: Close books by the 10th of every month. Produce reviewed P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statements in Finaloop. Resolve misclassifications proactively. Maintain a clean chart of accounts. No CEO intervention required.



Budgeting & Financial Planning: Prepare and maintain monthly, quarterly, and annual budgets. Own budget vs. actuals: produce variance reports monthly alongside the P&L close with plain-language explanations. Update balance sheet items and expenses weekly inside the company’s financial models.



Cash Flow Management & Forecasting: Maintain the 13-week cash flow forecast weekly and proactively. Flag upcoming cash movements, exposure, and risks before they become surprises. This is one of the most critical tools the CEO uses for capital allocation.



Payroll Operations (Zero-Error Standard): Own bi-weekly payroll across ADP (US) and Deel (Philippines). Submit the morning of payroll day, every cycle. PTO, overtime, and deductions captured before submission. You catch discrepancies before they reach the CEO.



Tax Coordination & Compliance: Own the relationship with Numeral on multi-state sales tax filings. Maintain the estimated tax payment tracker. Coordinate with our external CPA on annual filings. Flag tax exposure and timing proactively.

Vendor Payments, Disbursements & Financial Systems: Execute and double-check all vendor payments (Venmo, PayPal, wire). Track owner distributions and related-party transactions. Manage Finaloop, Shopify revenue reconciliation, and Google Sheets financial modeling. Manage financial admin including insurance, vendor accounts, and benefits.



CEO Reporting & Ad Hoc Analysis: Weekly: 13WCF update, flagged variances, upcoming cash movements. Monthly: clean financial statements with brief narrative. As needed: ad hoc financial analysis without requiring a detailed spec.



Why You Should Take This Role

-You’ll work at a brand obsessed with its customers, with a loyal following. Read the reviews: 
/pages/reviews

-A company that’s scaled rapidly in 4 years and is aggressively investing in growth.

-You’ll work hand-in-hand with the founder, not through layers of management, with full autonomy to own your domain.

-The company was founded to solve a personal problem - Tavish’s father battled a neurological condition for a decade and the family discovered the issues with plastic pill organizers.

-You’ll own the entire financial function for a company on a trajectory from $11.5M to $30M - a career-defining role for the right person.





Required Experience & Skills

-5+ years in accounting, bookkeeping, or finance operations

-Prior Controller or senior finance role at a company doing $10M+ in annual revenue - you’ve owned the full financial function, not just pieces of it

-E-commerce or DTC company experience strongly preferred - Shopify revenue recognition, inventory accounting, seasonal cash flow, multi-state sales tax

-Experience closing books independently, on a monthly cadence, without supervision

-Demonstrated accuracy record - you should be able to speak to this specifically

-US GAAP familiarity (CPA not required, but you must understand the principles)

-Experience preparing monthly, quarterly, and annual budgets

-Payroll experience across multiple platforms

-Advanced Google Sheets / Excel (SUMIFS, financial modeling, pivot tables)

-Strong proficiency with Finaloop, QuickBooks Online, or equivalent cloud accounting platform

-Strong written and verbal English; ability to explain financial insights to non-financial stakeholders





Nice-to-Have Experience

-Experience using Notion (or similar task management software)

-EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System) familiarity

-Prior experience coordinating with external CPAs and tax advisors





What We’re Really Looking For

-Technical skills get you in the door. These traits determine whether you succeed:

-Detail orientation as professional pride - you catch your own errors before they go out, and you change your process so they don’t recur.

-Proactive disclosure - you surface problems before being asked, even when it’s uncomfortable.

-Ownership without supervision - if it’s due, it’s done. No prompting required.

-Direct communication - you push back when something doesn’t look right.

-Reliability - when you say you’ll be available, you’re available. When you can’t be, you say so immediately.





Compensation Details & Schedule

-Work Hours: 50 hours/week, Monday–Friday. Core overlap with US Eastern hours (9AM–5PM EST).

-Paid Holidays: 10 paid holidays per year

title: Financial Controller
description:
Ikigai Cases is hiring a Controller!

Location: Remote / Work From Home

Reports to: CEO





About the Company

Ikigai Cases (
) is a fast-growing ecommerce brand manufacturing aerospace-grade aluminum pill cases. Founded in December 2021 by two brothers after their father’s neurological diagnosis led them to discovering the issues with plastic pill organizers, we’ve built a multi-million dollar business in just over four years with a team of 25 across the globe.



Our mission is simple: make exceptional pill cases and provide exceptional customer service. We deliver on this by managing in-house fulfillment at our Washington, DC facility (including custom engraving) and maintaining obsessive attention to detail.





About the Role

We are hiring a Controller to take complete ownership of our financial operations - accounting, reporting, payroll, budgeting, cash flow, tax coordination, and financial systems. This is a critical senior role, and we’re looking for someone whose professional identity is built around three things: the integrity of the numbers, running the finance function end-to-end, and providing strategic financial insight to the CEO.



The ideal candidate has served as a Controller (or equivalent) for an e-commerce or DTC brand in the $10–30M revenue range. You understand the financial rhythms of e-commerce: Shopify revenue recognition, inventory accounting, seasonal cash flow swings, sales tax across multiple states, and the speed at which decisions need to be made. If you’ve done this before at a similar-sized company, you already know what we need.



We need someone who builds systems, not just operates inside them. You’ll report directly to the CEO and work hand-in-hand with our external financial advisor. No layers of management between you and the decisions your work supports.





Core Responsibilities

Monthly Close & Financial Reporting: Close books by the 10th of every month. Produce reviewed P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statements in Finaloop. Resolve misclassifications proactively. Maintain a clean chart of accounts. No CEO intervention required.



Budgeting & Financial Planning: Prepare and maintain monthly, quarterly, and annual budgets. Own budget vs. actuals: produce variance reports monthly alongside the P&L close with plain-language explanations. Update balance sheet items and expenses weekly inside the company’s financial models.



Cash Flow Management & Forecasting: Maintain the 13-week cash flow forecast weekly and proactively. Flag upcoming cash movements, exposure, and risks before they become surprises. This is one of the most critical tools the CEO uses for capital allocation.



Payroll Operations (Zero-Error Standard): Own bi-weekly payroll across ADP (US) and Deel (Philippines). Submit the morning of payroll day, every cycle. PTO, overtime, and deductions captured before submission. You catch discrepancies before they reach the CEO.



Tax Coordination & Compliance: Own the relationship with Numeral on multi-state sales tax filings. Maintain the estimated tax payment tracker. Coordinate with our external CPA on annual filings. Flag tax exposure and timing proactively.

Vendor Payments, Disbursements & Financial Systems: Execute and double-check all vendor payments (Venmo, PayPal, wire). Track owner distributions and related-party transactions. Manage Finaloop, Shopify revenue reconciliation, and Google Sheets financial modeling. Manage financial admin including insurance, vendor accounts, and benefits.



CEO Reporting & Ad Hoc Analysis: Weekly: 13WCF update, flagged variances, upcoming cash movements. Monthly: clean financial statements with brief narrative. As needed: ad hoc financial analysis without requiring a detailed spec.



Why You Should Take This Role

-You’ll work at a brand obsessed with its customers, with a loyal following. Read the reviews: 
/pages/reviews

-A company that’s scaled rapidly in 4 years and is aggressively investing in growth.

-You’ll work hand-in-hand with the founder, not through layers of management, with full autonomy to own your domain.

-The company was founded to solve a personal problem - Tavish’s father battled a neurological condition for a decade and the family discovered the issues with plastic pill organizers.

-You’ll own the entire financial function for a company on a trajectory from $11.5M to $30M - a career-defining role for the right person.





Required Experience & Skills

-5+ years in accounting, bookkeeping, or finance operations

-Prior Controller or senior finance role at a company doing $10M+ in annual revenue - you’ve owned the full financial function, not just pieces of it

-E-commerce or DTC company experience strongly preferred - Shopify revenue recognition, inventory accounting, seasonal cash flow, multi-state sales tax

-Experience closing books independently, on a monthly cadence, without supervision

-Demonstrated accuracy record - you should be able to speak to this specifically

-US GAAP familiarity (CPA not required, but you must understand the principles)

-Experience preparing monthly, quarterly, and annual budgets

-Payroll experience across multiple platforms

-Advanced Google Sheets / Excel (SUMIFS, financial modeling, pivot tables)

-Strong proficiency with Finaloop, QuickBooks Online, or equivalent cloud accounting platform

-Strong written and verbal English; ability to explain financial insights to non-financial stakeholders





Nice-to-Have Experience

-Experience working remotely for a US-based company from the Philippines

-Exposure to sales tax compliance across multiple US states

-Experience using Notion (or similar task management software)

-EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System) familiarity

-Prior experience coordinating with external CPAs and tax advisors





What We’re Really Looking For

-Technical skills get you in the door. These traits determine whether you succeed:

-Detail orientation as professional pride - you catch your own errors before they go out, and you change your process so they don’t recur.

-Proactive disclosure - you surface problems before being asked, even when it’s uncomfortable.

-Ownership without supervision - if it’s due, it’s done. No prompting required.

-Direct communication - you push back when something doesn’t look right.

-Reliability - when you say you’ll be available, you’re available. When you can’t be, you say so immediately.





Compensation Details & Schedule

-Compensation: TBD based on candidate experience. Target compensation will be requested during screening.

-Work Hours: 50 hours/week, Monday–Friday. Core overlap with US Eastern hours (9AM–5PM EST).

-Paid Holidays: 10 paid holidays per year

-PTO: 1 week earned for every 6 months worked at the company

-Location: Remote / Work From Home





To Apply

Fill out the application form here: 
/jobs/6f92864d-dc4d-41bc
f7bcfcf498e

title: Email Designer for Ecom Brands (Figma) - Long Term
description:
ABOUT THIS ROLE: 

I run
 marketing for US e-commerce brands. I handle the strategy, the copy, the client relationship, and the Klaviyo build myself. Design is the one piece I want to hand off to someone else, and ideally grow a partnership with as we scale and add clients.



This is long-term. I'm not looking for a freelancer for a project. I'm looking for the person who designs every
 that leaves my desk for the next few years.



WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR:

- Real
 design experience. Your portfolio has actual
 campaigns in it.

- Range. You can design for a rugged masculine brand and a soft feminine one and have both look right, not one signature style applied to everything

- Comfortable working inside someone else's brand system instead of inventing your own

- Strong typography and hierarchy, and you think about how the design behaves on a phone

- Resourceful. If the brand's asset folder doesn't have the photo a section needs, you go find one or make one, and come to me with options rather than a problem

- Communicative. When something is unclear or a deadline is at risk, you tell me early. We can figure it out together. Silence is the worst thing you can do.

- Reliable written English, enough to handle a revision thread cleanly



WHAT YOU'D BE DOING: 

Designing
 campaigns in Figma from a finished copy document. I write every headline, sub-headline, and button label and hand it to you section by section.



Working inside each brand's existing style guide — fonts, hex codes, type scale, and button specs are already defined, but for certain design choices I will want to lean on your opinion.



Sourcing or generating supporting imagery when the brand's asset library doesn't have what a section needs. Roughly two rounds of revision per design, turned around quickly



You would NOT be writing copy, doing strategy, building in Klaviyo, or talking to clients. I handle all of that. Unless there is a point down the road where you would be interested in additional work.



YOUR WORKFLOW:

- I send you a finished copy document and the brand assets. You send back a Figma link. Revisions happen in the same file

- Roughly 20–25 designs per month to start, growing as I add clients

- $25 USD per design. At current volume with bonuses, that's $500–$1,000 per month. And it will be more once I onboard more clients (which I can't do until I have a designer)

- Paid twice monthly through Wise, or monthly if you prefer

- After a month or two, once the work is consistently on time and to standard, I'm open to setting a guaranteed monthly minimum of $750 so your income doesn't swing with my send calendar

- A short check-in call each week. Beyond that we work async



HOW TO APPLY:

Send me a message with all four of these:

- A link to your portfolio. If you don't have one, please don't apply. I need to see the work

- Which two brands in your portfolio look the LEAST like each other, and why

- How many hours a week you actually have available, what other ongoing work you're committed to, and what hours you could be online in US Central time

- Start your message with the word GRIND so I know you read this all the way through



I read every application and review every portfolio personally. If your work fits, I'll reach out for a short call. Looking forward to seeing your portfolio!

- You’re aware of new software and can look at current systems and identify how to automate tasks a company has been doing manually for months.

- You’re addicted to digital processes & automation in the world of social media because you love building connections in the digital space and you’ve seen how powerful it can be in business growth

- You overcommunicate clearly and confidently. If you agree/disagree with something, you communicate that without hesitation or overthinking. You’re no stranger to asking why we do things a certain way to ensure we’re intentional with our resources.

- You’re a leader and team player. Ego? What ego? If something needs to be done, you dive in to make sure all critical tasks are accounted and cared for.

title: Creative Operations Manager
description:
About the Role



Are you an agile, media-savvy coordinator who thrives in high-volume video production? Kipkeh Media is a rapidly expanding US media network seeking a high-agency Creative Operations Manager to act as the central engine connecting our field creators, intake team, and post-production video editors.



Vision & Role Overview

We don't need rigid operators who rely on static scripts; we need a proactive problem-solver who can manage evolving production schedules, review raw media assets, and keep content moving smoothly from raw capture to final publish across daily vlogs, commercial features, and local business spots.



Core Responsibilities



Agile Pipeline & Delivery Management: Oversee the full lifecycle of Kipkeh Media content, adapting quickly to shifting priorities, rapid turnarounds, and sudden updates without dropping the ball.

Pre-Edit Media Audit & QA: Review and audit incoming raw footage before handing off to video editors. Categorize assets, check audio/video quality, identify key promotional moments, and write precise creative briefs for editors on what to cut, keep, or emphasize.

Cross-Functional Team Alignment: Lead daily syncs across field creators (vloggers/hosts), remote intake specialists, and post-production editors to keep all parties aligned on publishing deadlines.

Workflow & SOP Optimization: Build, maintain, and refine tracking dashboards (Google Workspace, Slack, PM tools) to streamline media operations as our network scales.



Requirements & Qualifications



2+ Years Media/Agency Experience: Proven background as an Prject manager, Operations Coordinator, Production Lead, or Digital Media Project Manager in agency, marketing, or video environments.

Content Intuition & Sharp Eye: Excellent creative judgment for reviewing raw video, spotting engaging promotional hooks, and catching missing details prior to post-production.

Core Adaptability: Calm under pressure with a growth mindset that easily adjusts to fluid production schedules.

Cross-Cultural Communication: Advanced written and spoken English, paired with comfort managing raw video footage featuring niche or non-English community dialects.

Technical Mastery: Hands-on experience using Google Workspace (Sheets/Docs), Slack, and modern project management software.



Compensation & Growth



Hourly Rate: $5.00 – $6.50 USD / hour (scaled strictly to elite media coordination and process management capabilities).

Schedule: 40 hours per week with flexible scheduling structured around core US sync windows and editorial milestones.

Reliable Payments: Weekly delivery via Wise.

Growth Trajectory: Ground-floor path to advance into full operational leadership as our media ecosystem expands.



HOW TO APPLY (STRICT REQUIREMENTS)



We filter ruthlessly for attention to detail. If you do not follow these steps, your application will be automatically deleted.

Subject Line: Change your application subject line to this exact format: Creative Manager - Your Full Name

As a Dispatcher, you will be responsible for coordinating daily transportation operations, negotiating rates, assigning drivers, monitoring shipments, communicating with customers, and ensuring deliveries are completed safely, efficiently, and on time while maintaining compliance with DOT and ELD regulations.

We proudly serve businesses throughout the Northeast by providing dependable transportation solutions backed by honesty, integrity, urgency, teamwork, and exceptional customer service.



Key Responsibilities

Dispatch Operations

Respond professionally to customer inquiries.

Resolve delivery concerns while maintaining exceptional customer service.

Ensure compliance with DOT regulations, ELD requirements, Hours of Service (HOS), company policies, and customer-specific procedures.

Work closely with HR and Operations to ensure all regulatory requirements are met.

Strong ability to multitask and manage multiple drivers, customers, deliveries, and priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

Intermediate English communication skills (written and verbal).

Excellent organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.

Comfortable communicating professionally with drivers, customers, brokers, and internal teams.

Strong critical-thinking, decision-making, and problem-solving abilities.

title: Senior Amazon PPC & Advertising Strategist
description:
Remote | Full Time | US Eastern Hours | USD $1,500 - $2,500/month + 13th Month



*****************************************************************************************************

Founded in 2019, Elevated Seller is an Amazon growth agency managing advertising, listings, creative and catalogue for brands with over $30M in yearly managed Amazon revenue.

*****************************************************************************************************



We are hiring an experienced Amazon PPC person to take over a portfolio of 5-10 brands. 

Some are market leaders defending their position against competitors. Some are new to Amazon. Some are growing daily.



This is not a junior role and it is not a bid-adjustment role. If your Amazon experience is mostly executing inside campaign structures someone else designed, this is not for you.



*****************************************************************************************************



HOW TO APPLY:



Read the job specification thoroughly, then if you feel you are a good fit, go here to apply:

******



******

Be specific. Tell us the brands and categories you have worked on, approximate monthly ad spend, and results in numbers. 



*****************************************************************************************************



THE ROLE:



•  You will own advertising performance for 5-10 brands. You work out what each account actually needs, build the strategy with the client, and execute it yourself. This is a leadership position within our company with room to grow.

•  You are not handed a plan. You make the plan, agree it with the client, and are accountable for what happens next.

•  You form a view and back it with data. You own accounts, not tasks. You raise problems early rather than explaining them later. You are honest with clients when results are bad.



WHAT YOU NEED FOR THIS ROLE:



•  HOURS - Availability for a full US Eastern business day. This is when our clients are available.

•  EXPERIENCE - 4+ years hands-on Amazon advertising, managing real accounts and real budgets. 

•  AGENCY BACKGROUND - You have managed multiple brands at the same time in an agency. This is essential.

•  MEANINGFUL SPEND - You can tell us the largest monthly ad spend you have personally been responsible for, and we will ask about it.

•  BUSINESS THINKING - TACoS, ACoS, ROAS, conversion rate, CTR, CPC and budget utilisation as business metrics, not dashboard numbers. You understand how advertising interacts with organic rank, pricing, promotions, inventory and margin.

•  PLATFORM FLUENCY - You move around Seller Central and the Ads Console without thinking about it. You can build, launch and read sponsored ad reports with no learning curve.

•  ANALYTICAL - Advanced Excel and Google Sheets including bulk file work. You use AI tools to work faster.

•  CLIENT-READY ENGLISH - You will be on video calls with North American brand owners and executives. We care about clarity and confidence, not accent.



******************************************************************************************************



SPECIFIC JOB DUTIES:



•  Own strategy and daily execution across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display for 5-10 brands.

•  Build campaign structure, keyword and product targeting, match types, placements, dayparting and audience targeting from scratch.

•  Manage bids and budgets against each client's real goal - profitability, launch, share growth or defence.

•  Meet with clients regularly to set goals jointly, explain performance, present recommendations and answer hard questions honestly.

•  Monitor accounts closely enough to find problems before the client does.

•  Audit listings and diagnose when poor results are caused by something other than advertising - price, listing quality, reviews, inventory, Buy Box, competitors - and say so.

•  Work with our in-house graphics, copy and growth teams on listings, sponsored video, banners and hero images that lift CTR and conversion.

•  Bring new PPC strategies to the table. We want your ideas, not just your execution.



******************************************************************************************************



NICE TO HAVE (NOT REQUIRED):



•  Amazon DSP - audiences, retargeting, display and video

•  Amazon Marketing Cloud

•  Vendor Central, EU or UK marketplaces

•  Pacvue, Perpetua, Skai or similar

•  Other ad platforms - eBay, Google,

•  Helium 10, DataDive



******************************************************************************************************



We care far more about advertising judgement than any particular platform. Tools can be learned.



******************************************************************************************************



SALARY AND BENEFITS:



•  USD $1,000 - $2,500 per month, depending on experience and demonstrated ability

•  If you are above this range and believe you are worth it, apply anyway and tell us what you would need

•  Standard 13th month pay

•  Paid vacation days and paid sick days

•  National holidays

•  Access to almost unlimited software and systems for the latest in Amazon marketing

•  A friendly, long-tenured team with zero politics



******************************************************************************************************

Shortlisted candidates complete a practical task and a short video. There is no paid trial.



Good luck to all applicants.

title: Funnel Specialist
description:
About The Visionary Group (TVG)



Welcome to The Visionary Group. We are a close knit e-commerce growth team of brand builders, strategists, and marketers. We help companies scale to maximum their true potential by exploring DTC solutions best suit for their stage of business. Founded in 2022, our collection of fast paced tea
mbers is becoming filled with high priority work, which is where you come in!



What this position is responsible for:



We’re looking for a highly analytical and execution-focused DTC Funnel Optimization Specialist who can identify conversion bottlenecks, implement high-impact fixes, and continuously improve the customer journey across our eCommerce client portfolio. This role exists to bridge the gap between paid acquisition and on-site conversion performance, ensuring traffic generated by our Paid Media Strategists converts at the highest possible rate. You’ll own the diagnosis, testing, implementation, and reporting of funnel improvements while helping scale winning conversion strategies across multiple brands.



Requirements/Experience:



- 2+ years of experience in Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), DTC eCommerce, funnel optimization, or Shopify growth operations



- Strong working knowledge of Shopify and DTC customer acquisition funnels



- Experience using tools such as GA4, Triple Whale, Shopify Analytics, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, or similar analytics platforms



- Hands-on experience building and updating landing pages and pre-sale pages using Replo or similar no-code builders



- Familiarity with quiz funnel platforms such as Octane AI, Shop Quiz, TryNow, or related tools



- Experience implementing and analyzing A/B tests using tools like Convert, GLO, Intelligems, or equivalent testing platforms



- Strong understanding of key eCommerce conversion metrics including LP CVR, PDP CVR, ATC rate, checkout completion rate, AOV, and funnel conversion flow



- Ability to write high-converting CRO-focused copy including headlines, CTAs, benefit-driven bullets, and trust-building messaging



- Strong analytical thinking with the ability to prioritize opportunities based on impact and effort



- Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple client funnels simultaneously



- Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with Paid Media Strategists and internal stakeholders



- High attention to detail and strong bias toward execution and accountability



- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, performance-driven remote environment



Roles & Responsibilities for this position:



- Conduct monthly audits of each client’s full acquisition funnel, including the transition from ad creative to landing page/PDP, add-to-cart flow, checkout experience, and post-purchase confirmation journey



- Analyze funnel performance data using GA4, Triple Whale, Shopify Analytics, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, and related tools to identify drop-off points, friction areas, and conversion opportunities



- Develop and maintain a prioritized “funnel fix queue” for each client based on projected revenue lift, implementation effort, and business impact



- Collaborate closely with Paid Media Strategists to identify and communicate systemic funnel issues, including disconnects between ad messaging and landing page experience



- Build, launch, and optimize pre-sale pages in Replo to support paid acquisition campaigns and improve conversion performance



- Create, update, and maintain quiz funnels using tools such as Octane AI, Shop Quiz, TryNow, and similar platforms

Implement updates to product detail pages (PDPs) using Shopify-native apps and templated modules without requiring custom Liquid development



- Launch and optimize landing pages designed specifically for paid traffic campaigns and conversion-focused customer journeys



- Execute structured A/B testing initiatives using platforms such as Convert, GLO, or Intelligems, ensuring proper setup, tracking, and reporting



- Write and refine conversion-focused copy for headlines, subheads, product bullets, CTAs, badges, and other on-site conversion elements



- Run a minimum of two A/B tests per client each month, continuously iterating based on performance insights and learnings



- Maintain a centralized testing log documenting hypotheses, variants, results, learnings, and next-step recommendations across all client accounts



- Identify winning conversion patterns and scalable best practices, then templatize and implement them across the broader client portfolio



- Own and monitor core funnel performance metrics including landing page CVR, PDP CVR, ATC rate, checkout completion rate, AOV, quiz completion rate, and quiz-to-purchase rate



- Provide weekly funnel performance updates and actionable insights to Paid Media Strategists via Slack



- Contribute funnel performance insights and scorecard data to monthly client reporting deliverables



- Take full ownership of implementation timelines, optimization initiatives, and measurable funnel performance improvements across assigned accounts



Notes:

- Must be available to work CST hours

- ASAP hire - immediate availability preferred

- Must be based in the Philippines



Apply now!

title: Limousine / Black-Car Dispatcher (Live Trip Dispatch, WhatsApp + Google Sheets) - Tri-State NYC Experience Preferred
description:
Empire Black Truck is a fast-paced limousine and black-car transportation company serving the New York Tri-State area. Trips are posted in WhatsApp groups throughout the day and can be claimed by another company within seconds, so our dispatchers have to stay focused, react quickly, and make fast but accurate decisions.



This is a live-operations role. If you enjoy fast decisions, constant coordination and keeping every trip and every dollar accounted for, you will do well here.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



1) Claim jobs fast, and only the right ones

- Monitor multiple WhatsApp groups where transportation jobs are posted all day.

- Before accepting a job, immediately check our drivers' live locations, current assignments and upcoming schedules to confirm we can cover it.

- Accept and claim jobs within seconds when we can cover them.



2) Assign and confirm

- Assign or pre-book the appropriate driver for each accepted job.

- Send the complete trip information to the driver and confirm the driver received and acknowledged it.

- Check for scheduling conflicts and prevent double bookings.



3) Monitor every active trip

- Track each trip in real time: driver on location, passenger on board, trip completed.

- If a driver is late, unresponsive or has an issue, act immediately: contact the driver, update the appropriate person, and arrange backup coverage when needed.

- Handle airport pickups, flight delays and last-minute schedule changes calmly.



4) Keep the tracking sheet perfect

Every job must be entered into our Google Sheets tracker with:

- Trip date and time

- Pickup and drop-off locations

- Passenger information

- Assigned driver

- Company that provided the job, and the specific dispatcher who sent it

- Total job amount, driver pay, expected profit

- Payment terms, due date, and payment status (paid, pending or late)

This is how we know exactly who gave us each job and who we need to follow up with for payment, so accuracy is not optional.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Required

- Previous dispatch or live-operations experience in a fast-paced, last-mile environment.

- Excellent spoken and written English; you will be communicating with drivers, affiliates and clients constantly.

- Strong internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps download / 10 Mbps upload) with a backup connection, plus a backup power source. You must be reachable at all times during your shift.

- Comfortable working U.S. Eastern Time hours, including early mornings, evenings or weekends depending on the shift assigned.

- Confident with WhatsApp (groups, voice notes, quick replies) and Google Sheets (data entry, filters, formulas at a basic level).

- Calm under pressure, extremely organized, and able to make quick decisions without waiting to be told.



Strongly preferred

- Experience in limousine, black-car, taxi/rideshare, NEMT, airport transportation, courier, or food-delivery dispatch.

- Working knowledge of the New York Tri-State area: JFK, LGA, EWR, Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, the Bronx, Westchester, Long Island, New Jersey and Connecticut - including typical drive times and traffic patterns.

- Experience dispatching from affiliate networks or job-posting groups where trips are claimed first-come, first-served.

- Familiarity with limo/black-car software or booking platforms.



Please note: 3PL trucking, truckload scheduling and HVAC dispatch experience can be helpful, but those industries operate very differently from limousine and taxi dispatch. If your background is only in those areas, please explain clearly in your application how you would handle live passenger transportation, airport pickups and jobs that must be claimed within seconds.



HOW TO APPLY



Apply with the subject line: BLACK CAR DISPATCHER - [YOUR NAME]



In your application, answer all of the following. Applications that do not answer every question will not be reviewed.

1. Describe your dispatch experience. What industry, how many drivers/trips per day, and what tools did you use?

2. Have you dispatched passenger transportation (limo, black car, taxi, NEMT, airport)? Give one specific example of a problem trip and how you solved it.

3. A trip is posted in a WhatsApp group: JFK pickup at 6:00 PM today, drop-off in Midtown Manhattan. Walk us through, step by step, exactly what you check and do in the first 60 seconds.

4. Attach a screenshot of a speed test (speedtest.net) taken on the connection you would use for work, and tell us your backup internet and backup power setup.

5. What hours are you available in U.S. Eastern Time?

6. How familiar are you with the NYC Tri-State area? Roughly how long is JFK to Midtown at 5:00 PM on a weekday?



Shortlisted candidates will complete a short paid live-dispatch trial (WhatsApp + Google Sheets) before hiring.

title: Remote Bookkeeper
description:
Remote Bookkeeper



Company: B.D. Smith Wealth

Location: Remote, Philippines

Schedule: Full-time, Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM EST

Compensation: $6/hour

Time Tracking: Required during all working hours



Turn Your Accounting Skills Into Meaningful Work



B.D. Smith Wealth is looking for a dependable, detail-oriented Remote Bookkeeper who truly loves bookkeeping and takes pride in accurate, organized financial records.



This role is for someone who can eat, breathe, and live bookkeeping, someone who enjoys reconciliations, clean books, deadlines, and helping clients stay financially organized.



We help families and small business owners make confident financial decisions and build lasting wealth. You’ll join a growing team that values excellent work, continuous learning, clear communication, integrity, and a supportive working environment.



Important Requirements



To be considered, applicants must:



• Be a CPA

• Have a QuickBooks certification

• Have strong bookkeeping or accounting experience

• Be available full-time from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM EST

• Not have another employer, client, or job during working hours

• Be comfortable using a company-approved time tracker during all working hours

• Have reliable internet, backup internet, and a secure workspace

• Be willing to provide an NBI Clearance because this role handles sensitive client and financial information

• Submit a 2–3 minute introduction video with the application



APPLICATIONS WITHOUT AN INTRO VIDEO WILL NOT BE ENTERTAINED.



What You’ll Do



• Categorize business income and expenses

• Reconcile bank and credit card accounts

• Maintain accurate general ledger records

• Record journal entries and make necessary corrections

• Assist with monthly bookkeeping and financial close

• Prepare basic financial reports

• Review transactions for missing or inaccurate information

• Maintain organized client records and supporting documents

• Communicate questions and discrepancies promptly

• Protect confidential client and financial information

• Meet assigned deadlines and follow established procedures



You May Be a Great Fit If You



• Understand debits, credits, reconciliations, journal entries, and financial statements

• Have strong experience with QuickBooks Online

• Are comfortable using Microsoft Excel and cloud-based systems

• Have strong attention to detail

• Communicate clearly and professionally

• Can work independently without sacrificing accuracy

• Accept feedback well and enjoy learning

• Take ownership of your responsibilities and follow through

• Are looking for a long-term full-time role, not a side job



Our S.T.A.R. Values



Serve Like Jesus

Treat every client and teammate with compassion, humility, and care.



Take Accountability

Own your work, responsibilities, and opportunities to improve.



Act With Integrity and Excellence

Do what is right and produce work you are proud to submit.



Rejoice in the Journey

Maintain a positive attitude, celebrate progress, and support the team.



Compensation



$6 per hour

Full-time, 40 hours per week



How to Apply



Apply through this job posting and include:



• Your résumé/CV

• A brief introduction explaining why you would be a great addition to B.D. Smith Wealth

• A 2–3 minute introduction video

• Confirmation that you are a CPA

• Proof or screenshot of your QuickBooks certification

• Confirmation that you can work 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM EST full-time

• Confirmation that you do not have another employer, client, or job during working hours

• Confirmation that you are comfortable using a time tracker

• Confirmation that you are willing to provide an NBI Clearance



IMPORTANT: APPLICATIONS WITHOUT AN INTRO VIDEO WILL NOT BE ENTERTAINED.

title: Amazon PPC Specialist for New Product Launches and Management
description:
We are looking for an experienced Amazon PPC specialist to help launch and grow a small range of products on Amazon UK under our Simple Supplies brand.



Our current products include carpet refresher powders and fabric refresher sprays in two scents. The listings are already live and the imagery is in place. We now need someone who can take ownership of the advertising side and help us establish which products and keywords convert best.



The role will include setting up and managing Sponsored Product campaigns, keyword research, automatic and manual campaigns, product targeting, negative keywords, bid and budget optimisation, search term analysis and regular performance reviews.



We want someone who understands new product launches and can work carefully with a controlled budget while gathering useful data.



You should be able to report clearly on spend, sales, CPC, CTR, conversion rate, ACoS, TACoS where relevant, winning keywords and areas that need improvement.



Experience with Amazon UK, Seller Central, Helium 10 or similar Amazon research tools is preferred.



We are initially looking for a part time arrangement or paid trial, with the potential for ongoing work as we add more Simple Supplies products.



Please include examples of Amazon PPC campaigns you have managed, particularly new product launches, and explain how you would approach the first 14 days of advertising for a new listing with limited sales history.

title: Part-Time Super Administrator- Immediately Hiring
description:
HIRING IMMEDIATELY: Part-Time Super Administrator

Position: Part-Time Super Administrator – Operations & Quality Control

Company: Maybridge Development LLC

Industry: Government Construction

Location: Remote | North Carolina-based company

Schedule: Tuesday–Thursday, 5 hours per day

Hours: 15 hours per week

Working Time Zone: Eastern Time (U.S.)

Compensation: $500/month

Start Date: Immediately



About Maybridge

Maybridge Development LLC is a growing small-scale government construction company based in North Carolina.

We are looking for a Part-Time Super Administrator who can help us keep the company organized, accountable, and moving forward.



This is not a traditional administrative assistant or virtual assistant role.

We need someone who is fast, sharp, highly organized, learns quickly, moves with urgency, and naturally looks for what needs to be done next.



Your goal is to help us move the needle.



You will serve as an additional set of eyes for leadership — reviewing, auditing, following up, organizing, identifying risks, improving systems, and making sure things do not fall through the cracks.



What You'll Do



Company & Team Audits

• Conduct routine company and project audits to ensure team members are following established processes and completing their responsibilities.

• Review task lists, project documentation, and internal systems for incomplete or overdue items.

• Follow up with team members when something is missing, overdue, or needs correction.

• Identify recurring problems and bring them to leadership's attention.

• Help ensure team members are following their assigned roles and responsibilities.

• Make sure important tasks and responsibilities do not fall through the cracks.

Contracts, Work Orders & Risk Review

• Review contracts, work orders, scopes of work, and project documentation for completeness and consistency.

• Identify potential administrative, contractual, scheduling, or operational risks.

• Check deadlines, requirements, deliverables, and responsibilities.

• Flag anything that looks unclear, incomplete, inconsistent, or potentially risky for leadership to review.

Bid & Proposal Quality Control

• Review bid proposals before submission.

• Check grammar, spelling, formatting, consistency, accuracy, and professionalism.

• Check proposals for missing information or required documentation.

• Serve as an additional quality-control checkpoint before proposals are submitted.

 & Communication Management

• Review company
 and identify messages that have not received a response or appropriate follow-up.

• Identify
s that need to be assigned to a team member.

• Track important requests, deadlines, and action items.

• Make sure important communications do not get lost or forgotten.

• Flag anything requiring leadership's attention.

SOPs & Process Improvement

• Review existing SOPs and help keep them updated.

• Update SOPs when processes change.

• Identify gaps in current procedures and recommend improvements.

• Help ensure team members are actually following established SOPs.

• Maintain internal checklists, workflows, and process documentation.

• Help turn recurring problems into better systems and procedures.

File & Folder Organization

• Regularly audit company and project folders.

• Ensure documents are stored in the correct locations.

• Identify missing, duplicated, outdated, or incorrectly filed documents.

• Maintain organized digital records so the team can quickly find what they need.

• Help establish and maintain consistent file-naming and folder organization standards.

Administrative Support

• Assist leadership with administrative tasks and follow-up.

• Organize documents, spreadsheets, records, and company information.

• Send homeowner surveys and follow up on responses.

• Assist with scheduling, correspondence, data entry, and other operational needs.

• Support special projects as needed.

Social Media & Company Updates

• Assist with basic social media updates.

• Help gather project photos, updates, accomplishments, and company news.

• Assist with preparing content for social media and internal communications.



A Strong Eye for Presentation & Aesthetics!!!!



We are also looking for someone who takes pride in how things look.

You do not need to be a professional graphic designer, but you should have a good eye for aesthetics, organization, and professional presentation.



You should be able to look at a document, presentation, spreadsheet, template, or social media post and think:

"This could look better."



You may be asked to:

• Create or improve professional company templates.

• Put together clean, polished presentations.

• Format proposals, reports, checklists, and internal documents.

• Improve the layout and organization of spreadsheets and documents.

• Help create visually consistent company materials.

• Assist with social media graphics or basic visual content.

• Take existing information and turn it into something that is clear, professional, and visually appealing.



We want someone who takes pride in their work and understands that presentation matters.

Small details such as spacing, formatting, consistency, organization, and visual quality can make a big difference in how a company is perceived.



You do not have to be a designer. You do need to have good taste, attention to detail, and pride in what you put your name on.



The Person We're Looking For



You are someone who:

• Moves with urgency.

• Learns quickly and can pick up new systems, software, processes, and terminology without needing constant repetition.

• Is highly detail-oriented and catches things other people miss.

• Is proactive and does not wait around for someone to tell you what to do next.

• Can manage multiple priorities within a limited number of working hours.

• Communicates clearly and professionally.

• Is comfortable following up with coworkers and holding people accountable to their responsibilities.

• Is comfortable reviewing other people's work and professionally pointing out issues.

• Is tech-savvy and comfortable learning new software.

• Can work independently without constant supervision.

• Has good judgment and knows when something needs to be escalated.

• Enjoys solving problems rather than simply pointing them out.

• Takes pride in the quality and appearance of their work.

• Wants to grow with a small but growing company.



Fast Learner — This Is Important



We need someone who can learn quickly.



You should be able to learn a new process, understand why it exists, apply it correctly, and eventually identify when someone else is not following it.



You should be comfortable saying:



"I haven't done this before, but let me figure it out."



What Success Looks Like



This position is only 15 hours per week, so productivity matters.

We are not looking for someone to simply stay online for five hours.

We want those five hours to be highly productive.



After your first few weeks, we want you to become someone leadership can rely on to say:

"I checked it."

"I caught this."

"This is missing."

"This needs to be followed up on."

"This SOP needs to be updated."

"This
 hasn't been answered."

"This team member still has an outstanding task."

"I organized this."



"Here's the issue, and here's what I recommend we do."

Your value is not in how busy you look.

Your value is in how many things you catch, close, organize, improve, and move forward.



Construction Experience



Construction experience is highly preferred.



Experience with any of the following is a plus:

• Construction administration

• Government contracting

• Project coordination

• Contract administration

• Compliance

• Quality control

• Proposal/bid preparation

• Document control

• Operations

• Administrative support



We care just as much about how you think and how you work as we do about your previous job title.



You do not need to know everything on Day 1.



You do need to be able to learn.



This Role Is NOT For You If...

• You need to be told what to do every step of the day.

• You move slowly when something requires urgency.

• You struggle to learn new systems or processes.

• You frequently miss details or deadlines.

• You are uncomfortable following up with people.

• You do not like wearing multiple hats.

• You prefer to wait for instructions rather than take initiative.

• You need constant supervision to stay productive.

• You do not take pride in the quality or appearance of your work.

• You are looking for a role where you simply complete assigned tasks and log off.



Why Maybridge?

We are a small but growing construction company, which means your work will actually matter.

You will have the opportunity to learn about construction, government contracting, operations, compliance, project management, and business growth while working directly with leadership.



As Maybridge grows, this position WILL grow with it.



We are looking for someone who wants to build something with us — not someone who is simply looking for another job.

If you are a fast learner, move with urgency, have strong attention to detail, take pride in your work, and want an opportunity to grow with a growing company, we want to hear from you.



Please submit your resume and tell us why you believe you would be a strong fit for this position.

title: SEO Specialist with Web Development Experience Required
description:
We're Recruiting a SEO Specialist with Web Development Experience Required



APPLY HERE: 
/
: 



About Allied Health Media



Allied Health Media (Allied Health Media Limited) is a UK healthcare marketing agency, headquartered in London, founded by Abhay Patel in 2022. It helps private medical consultants grow their practices through AI-driven visibility and patient acquisition — ranking them top-3 on Google Maps and AI search to drive self-pay patient calls. Its core offerings include the 12-month Practice Authority Accelerator program, a website design/build service with ongoing retainer, and the Medical Authority Media Series for video and personal branding, all delivered through an in-house team spanning growth, CS, SEO, production, design, and development.



About the Role



As our SEO Specialist, you'll own the organic search performance of a portfolio of client websites, most of them in healthcare. That means running full technical and on-page audits, catching crawling, indexing, and architecture issues before they hurt rankings, and keeping Core Web Vitals, structured data, and site health in good shape. You'll turn findings into clear, actionable tasks for developers and content teams, then verify the fixes actually landed correctly on the live site — not just take someone's word for it. You'll also track performance through GA4 and Search Console, investigate unusual traffic or ranking shifts, and report on what's working, what isn't, and what should happen next. Because our clients operate in healthcare, you'll need to apply extra care and sound judgement around medical content accuracy, not just chase quick wins.



Do Not Apply If...



You rely solely on automated tool scores instead of professional judgement

You don't follow through to confirm that requested fixes were actually implemented correctly

You're uncomfortable explaining technical SEO issues to non-technical team members

You cut corners on accuracy, especially with medical/healthcare content

You need close supervision to manage multiple client websites and priorities

You're not comfortable learning new SEO tools and platforms.

You don't have a background or practical experience in web development.



Key Responsibilities



Conduct comprehensive technical SEO audits, covering crawling, indexing, rendering, and site architecture.

Review and optimise XML sitemaps, robots.txt, canonical tags, redirects, and URL structures.

Monitor Core Web Vitals, page speed, and mobile usability.

Review and troubleshoot structured data and schema markup.

Monitor Google Search Console for indexing, crawling, and performance issues, and investigate unusual changes.

Support website migrations, redesigns, and staging-to-live launches.

Optimise on-page elements — titles, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, and internal linking.

Identify duplicate, thin, or competing pages and recommend consolidation or redirection.

Review and QA completed SEO and development work across desktop, tablet, and mobile before sign-off.

Retest and verify that requested fixes have been implemented correctly on the live site.

Monitor organic traffic, rankings, and conversions via GA4, and prepare clear performance reports.

Coordinate with developers, designers, and content teams — writing clear, actionable SEO tasks.

Apply extra care, accuracy, and professional judgement when working with healthcare and medical content.



Skills and Tools Required



At least two years of practical SEO experience.

Strong knowledge of technical SEO and on-page optimisation.

Experience conducting detailed website audits and prioritising fixes by impact.

Understanding of crawling, indexing, canonicalisation, redirects, and URL structures.

Experience with structured data/schema markup and Core Web Vitals.

Familiarity with WordPress or a similar CMS, plus basic HTML/CSS.

Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.

Experience working with developers and verifying completed fixes.

Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical issues simply.

Working knowledge of Google Search Console, GA4, and Google Tag Manager.

Experience with SEO platforms such as Screaming Frog, Ahrefs, or Semrush.

Familiarity with PageSpeed Insights/Lighthouse, Looker Studio, and schema validation tools.



Compensation



We offer a competitive, performance-based package tailored to your experience and track record, with room to grow as you take on more client responsibility. This is a long-term opportunity with a stable, growing agency — not a short-term contract — and we reward accuracy, reliability, and great work with real career progression.



Why Join Us?



Work across a real portfolio of client websites, including meaningful healthcare projects where your work genuinely matters.

Join a fast-growing team where your audits and recommendations directly shape client results.

Flexible, remote-friendly setup with a supportive, collaborative team culture.

Room to grow into more senior SEO or strategy roles as the company scales.

Exposure to a variety of tools, platforms, and industries — never the same day twice.

A team that values professional judgement, accuracy, and follow-through over vanity metrics.





Ready to Join a Fast-Growing Team?

If you take pride in thorough audits, clear recommendations, and following through until it's actually fixed, we'd love to hear from you. Apply below and show us what you can do.

title: GoHighLevel Automation + AI Specialist - Workflows and AI (PHP 35k)
description:
ABOUT US



We are an Australian digital marketing agency. We build lead generation systems for construction, trade and home service businesses: solar, electrical, air conditioning, plumbing, bathrooms and builders. We run the ads, we build the pages, and we wire the whole thing into GoHighLevel so every lead is tracked from the ad click through to the booked job.



We are small, fast and AI first. You will work directly with the founder.



We have not named the company in this ad on purpose. If your application gets through the first screen, we tell you exactly who we are by
, before any interview.



THE ROLE, AND WHICH OF OUR TWO GOHIGHLEVEL ADS YOU SHOULD APPLY FOR



We are hiring two GoHighLevel specialists at the same time, and we are running two ads so the right person lands in the right seat.



This ad is the automation and AI seat. Workflows, pipelines, triggers, conditions, webhooks, phone, and the AI features inside GoHighLevel. You are the person who makes the system behave.



The other ad is the design seat. Websites, funnels and pages built inside GoHighLevel that do not look like GoHighLevel. That person makes the system look right.



The two of you will work side by side every day, in the same sub-accounts. So each of you needs a working knowledge of the other half. You will build a page sometimes. They will fix a workflow sometimes. But we are hiring each of you for your strong side, and we will screen you on your strong side.



If workflows, integrations and AI are what you are best at, this is your ad. If what you are best at is making pages look great, apply for the design ad instead, not this one. Please do not apply for both. Pick the seat that is actually you and we will read it properly.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Automations and workflows. This is the seat.

- Build workflows from scratch: triggers, filters, conditions, wait steps, if and else branches, goal events, internal notifications, and the tidy-up steps most people forget

- Speed to lead, missed call text back, nurture sequences, appointment reminders, no-show recovery, review requests, database reactivation

- Design pipelines end to end. Stages that mean something, automation moving opportunities between them, opportunity value, rotting rules, and reporting a tradesman can read without a tutorial

- Inbound webhooks in, outbound webhooks out. Custom values, custom fields, mapping a JSON payload onto a contact record correctly the first time

- Native first. When a workflow genuinely has to leave the platform you use n8n, Make or Zapier, and you can say why GoHighLevel could not do it on its own

- Debugging. Open the execution logs, find the step that failed, work out whether it is the trigger, the filter, the data or the integration, and fix it



AI inside GoHighLevel. The other half of the seat.

- Conversation AI, voice AI, booking bots and the AI employee features. Writing the prompt, setting the guardrails, d
 when it hands off to a human, and testing it against real conversations before it ever talks to a real lead

- AI that qualifies a lead, books the appointment and moves the opportunity, with a human alerted the moment it goes off script

- The AI never quotes a price. You build that guardrail in and you prove it holds

- You use AI in your own work every day. We give you a Claude account. You use it to draft, debug and document faster, and you know when not to trust it



Build in GoHighLevel. The half you support.

- Funnels and pages inside the builder when the design seat is at capacity: opt-in, booking and thank you pages, forms and surveys

- Enough custom CSS to fix a page. Designing one is the other seat

- Reusable snapshots so a new sub-account is stood up fast rather than rebuilt from zero



Measurement

- Meta Pixel and Conversions API on funnels, verified in Events Manager, with event ID deduplication

- Google Tag Manager, GA4 key events, Google Ads conversion tags

- UTM, GCLID and fbclid captured into contact custom fields so a lead maps back to the exact ad

- Meta lead ads wired in with correct field mapping and instant speed to lead

- Test every form, trigger link, calendar and redirect before it goes live, and keep the screenshot that proves it fired



Phone, domains and deliverability

- LC Phone or Twilio numbers set up properly, including the registration a new number needs before it is allowed to send

- Call routing, IVR and missed call handling that actually rings the right person

- Sending domains done properly: SPF, DKIM, DMARC, domain authentication in LC
 or Mailgun, and you know why mail lands in spam when those are wrong

- You know the difference between a DNS change that is safe and one that takes a client's
 offline, and you check before you change



Compliance

- Every outbound message carries a working opt out. Australian Spam Act. Not negotiable

- Document what you build so someone else can pick it up



THE MONEY, PLAINLY



PHP 35,000 per month to start. That is the number on the card and it is what this seat pays from day one.



Separately, and honestly: there is more available for someone genuinely exceptional who can prove it. If your number is above 35,000, do not skip this ad. Apply, name your number, and describe the builds that justify it. We would rather have that conversation than never see your application.



On day one you get a written standard describing exactly what good delivery looks like in this seat. At 60 days we review your delivery against that written standard. You will know before you start what you are being measured against.



THE ARRANGEMENT, IN PLAIN TERMS



Please read this section properly. We would rather you d
 it is not for you today than discover something you did not expect in week three.



- This is an independent contractor engagement. It is not employment. You invoice us each pay period and we pay the invoice.

- You are responsible for your own tax and any local statutory contributions. We do not withhold tax. We do not pay SSS, PhilHealth or Pag-IBIG.

- There is no paid annual leave. There is no paid sick leave. There is no 13th month pay. We are telling you this in the ad rather than letting you find it out later.

- You are paid twice a month, in PHP, by Wise.

- Hours are 7:00am to 3:30pm Philippine time, Monday to Friday. 40 hours a week.

- Full time and exclusive for the engagement. Exclusive means what it says: while you are engaged with us you do not hold other retained clients and you do not work for another agency, evenings and weekends included. If you have existing commitments, tell us at application stage.

- 3 month probation.

- There is a PAID test task before any offer, and for this seat it is a real workflow build in a sandbox sub-account. We pay you for the time you spend on it, whether or not we make you an offer.

title: DTC Funnel Optimization Specialist - PH based
description:
About The Visionary Group (TVG)



Welcome to The Visionary Group. We are a close knit e-commerce growth team of brand builders, strategists, and marketers. We help companies scale to maximum their true potential by exploring DTC solutions best suit for their stage of business. Founded in 2022, our collection of fast paced tea
mbers is becoming filled with high priority work, which is where you come in!



What this position is responsible for:



We’re looking for a highly analytical and execution-focused DTC Funnel Optimization Specialist who can identify conversion bottlenecks, implement high-impact fixes, and continuously improve the customer journey across our eCommerce client portfolio. This role exists to bridge the gap between paid acquisition and on-site conversion performance, ensuring traffic generated by our Paid Media Strategists converts at the highest possible rate. You’ll own the diagnosis, testing, implementation, and reporting of funnel improvements while helping scale winning conversion strategies across multiple brands. 



Requirements/Experience:



- 2+ years of experience in Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), DTC eCommerce, funnel optimization, or Shopify growth operations



- Strong working knowledge of Shopify and DTC customer acquisition funnels



- Experience using tools such as GA4, Triple Whale, Shopify Analytics, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, or similar analytics platforms



- Hands-on experience building and updating landing pages and pre-sale pages using Replo or similar no-code builders



- Familiarity with quiz funnel platforms such as Octane AI, Shop Quiz, TryNow, or related tools



- Experience implementing and analyzing A/B tests using tools like Convert, GLO, Intelligems, or equivalent testing platforms



- Strong understanding of key eCommerce conversion metrics including LP CVR, PDP CVR, ATC rate, checkout completion rate, AOV, and funnel conversion flow



- Ability to write high-converting CRO-focused copy including headlines, CTAs, benefit-driven bullets, and trust-building messaging



- Strong analytical thinking with the ability to prioritize opportunities based on impact and effort



- Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple client funnels simultaneously



- Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with Paid Media Strategists and internal stakeholders



- High attention to detail and strong bias toward execution and accountability



- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, performance-driven remote environment



Roles & Responsibilities for this position:



- Conduct monthly audits of each client’s full acquisition funnel, including the transition from ad creative to landing page/PDP, add-to-cart flow, checkout experience, and post-purchase confirmation journey



- Analyze funnel performance data using GA4, Triple Whale, Shopify Analytics, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, and related tools to identify drop-off points, friction areas, and conversion opportunities



- Develop and maintain a prioritized “funnel fix queue” for each client based on projected revenue lift, implementation effort, and business impact



- Collaborate closely with Paid Media Strategists to identify and communicate systemic funnel issues, including disconnects between ad messaging and landing page experience



- Build, launch, and optimize pre-sale pages in Replo to support paid acquisition campaigns and improve conversion performance



- Create, update, and maintain quiz funnels using tools such as Octane AI, Shop Quiz, TryNow, and similar platforms

Implement updates to product detail pages (PDPs) using Shopify-native apps and templated modules without requiring custom Liquid development



- Launch and optimize landing pages designed specifically for paid traffic campaigns and conversion-focused customer journeys



- Execute structured A/B testing initiatives using platforms such as Convert, GLO, or Intelligems, ensuring proper setup, tracking, and reporting



- Write and refine conversion-focused copy for headlines, subheads, product bullets, CTAs, badges, and other on-site conversion elements



- Run a minimum of two A/B tests per client each month, continuously iterating based on performance insights and learnings



- Maintain a centralized testing log documenting hypotheses, variants, results, learnings, and next-step recommendations across all client accounts



- Identify winning conversion patterns and scalable best practices, then templatize and implement them across the broader client portfolio



- Own and monitor core funnel performance metrics including landing page CVR, PDP CVR, ATC rate, checkout completion rate, AOV, quiz completion rate, and quiz-to-purchase rate



- Provide weekly funnel performance updates and actionable insights to Paid Media Strategists via Slack



- Contribute funnel performance insights and scorecard data to monthly client reporting deliverables



- Take full ownership of implementation timelines, optimization initiatives, and measurable funnel performance improvements across assigned accounts



Notes:

- Must be available to work CST hours

- ASAP hire -  immediate availability preferred

- Must be based in the Philippines



Apply now!

title: Content Assistant (AI-Assisted Writing, Translation & WordPress)
description:
Tropic Traffic is a digital marketing agency running 700+ websites worldwide. We have a technical team handling infrastructure, so you won't be doing server work or plugin maintenance. Your focus is content: writing it, translating it, publishing it, and keeping it accurate.



About the role



We're looking for one person to own our content production and keep our sites up to date. You'll use AI tools daily — but we're not hiring someone to paste ChatGPT output into WordPress. We're hiring someone with editorial judgment: who writes a good brief before the draft, and knows what to fix after it.



You'll also be hands-on in WordPress beyond just publishing text — building out pages, adding new sections and elements, restructuring content that's gone stale.



There's also a weekly quality check on our most important pages. It's detail work, and it matters, because we're paying for the traffic that lands there.



What you'll do



Content production (the bulk of the job)



Write and edit articles using AI tools, with proper briefs and real editing

Maintain our house style so everything sounds like us, not like a chatbot

Source images, format posts, and publish in WordPress

Build and maintain a prompt library so output stays consistent



Translation and localization



Translate articles into our target markets using AI, then localize properly

Adapt currencies, units, local merchants, seasonal references and idioms — not just swap the words



Weekly page checks (about half a day, every Monday)



Walk through 50 key pages the way a visitor would

Click each affiliate link and confirm it lands on the right product

Check that price and stock match what our article says

Confirm tracking parameters survive the redirect

Check mobile display, images and buttons

Log everything in a shared sheet and flag anything that needs attention



Keeping our sites up to date



Update outdated information, prices and product mentions in older posts

Add new sections, tables, comparison blocks, CTAs and other elements to existing pages

Build out new pages and landing pages using our existing templates and page builder

Restructure and rewrite articles that have gone stale, not just patch the numbers

Swap out images, banners and product boxes when things change

Fix internal links, refresh seasonal content, general on-page tidying

Roll out changes consistently across multiple sites when we update something everywhere



Also



Social media posts

Research tasks

Writing SOPs for everything you learn, so we build a proper knowledge base



Nice to have, when there's capacity



Helping organize our newsletters — topic planning, drafting, scheduling

What we need from you



Required



Excellent written English — clear, natural, not stiff

Solid WordPress experience — comfortable building and editing pages, not just publishing text. Tell us which page builder or theme you've worked with (Elementor, Gutenberg, Divi, etc.)

Daily working fluency with ChatGPT or Claude, and the judgment to know when their output isn't good enough

Genuine attention to detail — the weekly checks are the kind of task where skimming costs us money

Ability to follow a decision protocol and escalate the right things, rather than asking about every small call



Nice to have



Additional languages: [list your target languages here]


 or Zapier experience

Ahrefs or general SEO familiarity

Canva or basic image editing

What it's like working with us

Clear processes and decision rules, so you're not guessing

Direct communication, no layers of approval

The afternoon-to-evening schedule gives us real overlap with the European team, so you get answers the same day instead of waiting overnight

Early finish option on Fridays

Long-term role — we want someone who grows into owning this area, not a short project

How to apply

Two writing samples in your own words — not AI-generated. A blog post, an essay, anything that shows how you actually write.

You communicate with the people who have the missing information.



You track progress.



You follow up.



And you help get the project completed.



That is the type of person we're looking for.



## About Connor’s Pest Pros



Connor’s Pest Pros is a growing U.S. pest management company operating across multiple markets.



We're building the systems, technology, training, and management infrastructure needed to continue growing the company.



You will work directly with ownership and become involved in projects across many areas of the business.



For the right person, this can become a **long-term and increasingly important position within our company.**



## Work Schedule

Because you will work directly with the owner and U.S.-based team members, **some availability during U.S. Eastern Time business hours will be required.**



Please clearly state your availability when applying.



## HOW TO APPLY



Please include the following:



1. Tell us about your experience as an Executive Assistant, Project Coordinator, or similar position.

**CONNOR PROJECT READY**

We're looking for someone who thinks like a **project owner**, not simply someone who waits for tasks.
