title: Outbound Cold Calling & Appointment Setter – B2B Sales Hunter
description:
Outbound Cold Calling & Appointment Setter – B2B Sales Hunter



Full Time | Monday–Friday | 9:00am–5:00pm Perth, Western Australia Time



QPC Group is an established Australian office technology company providing Managed Print Services, printers and photocopiers, VoIP phone systems and other business technology solutions.



We are looking for an experienced B2B outbound cold caller and appointment setter.



This is a pure HUNTER role.



There are ZERO leads provided to you.



You will be responsible for researching your target market, building your own prospect lists, identifying the correct decision-makers, cold calling businesses and generating qualified appointments for our Australian Sales Team.



If your experience is primarily answering inbound calls, working supplied leads or calling warm databases, this role is not for you.



What You Will Do



You will be given the industries and target markets we want to pursue.



From there, you own the process.



You will be responsible for:



* Researching businesses within our target markets.

* Creating and maintaining your own prospecting lists.

* Using LinkedIn and other online sources to research businesses.

* Identifying the correct decision-maker within each organisation.

* Understanding which job titles to target depending on the business.

* Finding IT Managers, IT Directors, Owners, General Managers, Purchasing/Procurement Officers, Office Managers and other relevant decision-makers.

* Researching names, company details, phone numbers and other useful information before calling.

* Calling businesses completely cold.

* Asking for the decision-maker by name wherever possible, rather than simply asking reception who handles something.

* Navigating receptionists and gatekeepers professionally.

* Speaking confidently with Australian businesses.

* Starting conversations and uncovering opportunities.

* Identifying pain points and potential requirements.

* Generating qualified leads.

* Booking appointments directly for our Sales Team.

* Recording accurate prospect and call information.

* Following up prospects when appropriate.



This Is 100% Outbound Cold Calling



We want to be extremely clear about this.



We will NOT provide you with leads to call.



You need to know how to go from:



Target Market → Research → Company → Decision-Maker → Contact Details → Cold Call → Conversation → Qualified Appointment



We are looking for someone who has done this extensively before.



You need to genuinely enjoy prospecting and cold calling.



You should be comfortable hearing “no”, making another call and continuing until you find an opportunity.



We don’t want someone who waits for leads.



We want a hunter who creates them.



You Must Have



* Extensive previous B2B outbound cold-calling experience.

* Proven appointment-setting experience.

* Experience creating your own prospecting/call lists.

* Strong LinkedIn research skills.

* Ability to identify decision-makers based on job titles and company structures.

* Excellent spoken English.

* Confidence speaking with Australian business customers.

* Strong communication and questioning skills.

* Experience navigating gatekeepers.

* Ability to work independently.

* Strong research skills.

* Confidence working to activity and appointment targets.

* Resilience and persistence.



Please only apply if you have extensive experience doing this type of work.



Working Hours



This is a full-time position:



Monday to Friday

9:00am – 5:00pm Perth, Western Australia time



You must be available for the full shift.



IMPORTANT – Voice Recording Required



Because this is a telephone-based sales position, your voice recording is an essential part of your application.



Please record yourself delivering the following as though you were speaking to a real Australian business prospect:



“Hi, my name is [YOUR NAME] from QPC Group. We are an office technology company. We provide managed print services and VoIP phone systems. I’d love to know which one’s your biggest pain point in your office to see how we can help you today.”



Don’t rush through it or simply read the words.



We want to hear your natural telephone voice, confidence, energy and spoken English.



How to Apply



Your application MUST have the following subject line:



Outbound Sales Genius



Please include:



1. Your voice recording using the script above.

2. A summary of your previous B2B cold-calling and appointment-setting experience.

3. Explain how you have previously built your own prospect lists and found decision-makers.

4. Your CV/resume.

5. Your internet speeds and backup plan for power and internet outages .

6. Confirmation that you can work Monday–Friday, 8:00am–5:00pm Perth time.



Minimum Apply Points: 3



Applications using fewer than 3 Apply Points will not be considered.



If you’re an experienced outbound salesperson who knows how to research a market, find the right person, pick up the phone and create opportunities from absolutely nothing, we’d like to hear from you.

title: Project Coordinator- Construction
description:
IMMEDIATE HIRING: PROJECT COORDINATOR — CONSTRUCTION

Remote | Full-Time | 

Maybridge Development LLC | North Carolina-Based Government Construction Company



WE ARE HIRING IMMEDIATELY



We are looking for a Project Coordinator with construction experience to join our growing team.

This is a fast-moving position for someone who is organized, proactive, detail-oriented, and moves with urgency.

Your goal is simple:

Help us move the needle.

We do not want someone who waits to be told what to do every step of the way. We need someone who can look at what is happening across our projects, identify what needs attention, take action, follow up with the right people, and keep things moving.

If you are someone who naturally thinks:

“What needs to happen next?”

—you may be a great fit for this position.



ABOUT MAYBRIDGE

Maybridge Development LLC is a growing North Carolina-based government construction company specializing in construction, restoration, energy efficiency, and government contracting.



We work on projects for government agencies and are building a company with strong systems, processes, and a high standard of execution.

Because we are growing quickly, we need people who can keep up with the pace of the company.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

As Project Coordinator, you will be responsible for keeping projects, documentation, communication, and administrative processes organized and moving forward.

Your responsibilities include:

• Coordinate project activities, deadlines, and deliverables

• Track open tasks and follow up until they are completed

• Monitor project status and identify items that are falling behind

• Coordinate communication between Project Managers, field staff, subcontractors, vendors, and internal team members

• Maintain accurate project files and documentation

• Review contracts, work orders, proposals, reports, invoices, and other project documents

• Review documents for accuracy, completeness, grammar, and inconsistencies

• Prepare and organize bid and proposal documentation

• Track outstanding documentation and follow up with responsible team members

• Coordinate site visit scheduling and project-related logistics

• Maintain project management systems and update project information

• Track project requirements and deadlines

• Support project closeout and ensure required documentation is completed

• Identify gaps in our processes and bring them to leadership's attention

• Help create, improve, and maintain company SOPs and workflows

• Conduct administrative and project audits

• Monitor whether team members are following established processes

• Communicate issues quickly when something is off track

• Complete administrative and operational projects assigned by leadership

• Support company communications and social media updates when needed



CONSTRUCTION EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED

You must have some previous experience in construction or a closely related industry.

However, you should already understand basic construction terminology and how construction projects operate.

You should be familiar with things such as:

• Scope of work

• Work orders

• Contracts

• Bid proposals

• Change orders

• Subcontractors

• Project schedules

• Site visits

• Punch lists

• Project documentation

• Invoices

• Project closeout



We do not want to spend months teaching someone the basics of construction.

You should be able to enter a construction environment and understand what you are looking at.



WE ARE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO:

Moves with urgency.

This is one of the most important qualities we are looking for.

You should be someone who:

• Responds quickly

• Takes action without constant direction

• Follows through

• Notices when something is missing

• Follows up without being asked

• Doesn't let tasks sit unnecessarily

• Can prioritize competing deadlines

• Learns fairly quickly

• Is highly organized

• Has strong attention to detail

• Communicates clearly

• Can work independently

• Is comfortable being held accountable

• Looks for solutions instead of simply identifying problems

• Wants to grow with a company

You do not need to be bubbly or overly outgoing.

We care about urgency, accuracy, ownership, communication, and execution.



THIS IS NOT A "WAIT FOR INSTRUCTIONS" JOB



If your working style is:

“I finished what I was assigned, so now I'll wait.”



This probably isn't the right position for you.

We want someone who sees an unfinished task and thinks:



“This needs to get done. Who do I need to contact? What information am I missing? What can I do right now to move this forward?”



That mindset is extremely important to us.



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS

We move quickly, and we believe performance should be evaluated based on actual results.

You will have a 30-day performance review.

During your first 30 days, we will evaluate:

• Speed and urgency

• Accuracy

• Follow-through

• Communication

• Organization

• Ability to learn our systems

• Ability to work independently

• Ability to manage multiple priorities

• Initiative

• Overall contribution to the team



We want to know one thing:



Are you helping us move the needle?



SOFTWARE EXPERIENCE

Experience with any of the following is a plus:

• Fieldwire

• Procore

• Buildertrend

• 

• Asana

• ClickUp

• Microsoft Office

• Google Workspace

• Slack

You do not need to know every system. You do need to be comfortable learning new software quickly.



THIS POSITION IS A GOOD FIT FOR YOU IF...

You enjoy being the person who keeps things organized.

You like solving problems.

You notice details other people miss.

You don't need someone checking on you every hour.

You like a fast-paced environment.

You want to grow into greater responsibility.

And most importantly, you take pride in getting things done.



HOW TO APPLY

Please send:

1. Your resume

2. A voice recording 

 Tell us about yourself

 A brief description of your construction experience

 The construction/project management software you have used



Answer this question in your application:

You are reviewing a construction project and notice that an important document is missing, a team member has not completed an assigned task, and a deadline is approaching. What would you do?

We are looking for how you think and how you take action, not a textbook answer.

Applications that do not answer this question will not be considered.



ONE LAST THING



We are a growing company.

That means there will be a lot to do, priorities will change, and there will be opportunities to take on more responsibility.

We are looking for someone who wants to grow with Maybridge, not someone who is simply looking for another job.

If you are smart, organized, fast-moving, and ready to contribute, we want to hear from you.

3. Strong communication and patient engagement skills.

title: Internal Finance Manager / Senior Management Accountant (Accounting Degree Required)
description:
Internal Finance Manager / Senior Management Accountant



Full-Time | Work From Home | Australian Accounting Experience Required



***About the Role



We are seeking a strong, commercially minded and highly organised Internal Finance Manager / Senior Management Accountant to take ownership of the internal finance function for a growing Australian group of businesses.

This is a hands-on, all-rounder accounting role. You will be responsible for the complete finance cycle — from day-to-day transactions and reconciliations through to month-end close, management reporting, budgeting, cash flow forecasting, job costing, profitability analysis and KPI reporting.



You will also take ownership of important group financial administration, including insurance, licences and other renewals, and provide confidential financial support to the Founder.



This is not a purely transactional bookkeeping role, nor is it a position for someone who only reviews work prepared by others.



We need someone who can personally get into the detail, make sure the numbers are right, analyse what they mean and give management clear financial visibility.



You will work closely with the Founder and management team and play an important role in improving profitability, cash flow, financial controls and decision-making across the Group.



**Key Responsibilities



1. Day-to-Day Accounting & Finance



Take ownership of the day-to-day internal accounting function across multiple entities, including:

•	Bank and credit card reconciliations

•	Accounts payable and accounts receivable oversight

•	Payroll and payroll-related reconciliations

•	Intercompany transactions and reconciliations

•	Balance sheet reconciliations

•	Fixed asset and accounting schedules

•	Correct transaction coding and supporting documentation

•	Investigation and correction of accounting discrepancies

•	Maintenance of accurate and up-to-date financial records

•	Identification of unusual transactions, errors and control weaknesses



You will be expected to remain hands-on and capable of completing detailed accounting work yourself when required.



2. Month-End Closing & Management Accounts



Take full ownership of the month-end process, including:

•	Month-end journals

•	Accruals and prepayments

•	Payroll reconciliations

•	Balance sheet reconciliations

•	Intercompany reconciliations

•	Revenue and expense cut-off

•	Review of P&L and balance sheet

•	Investigation of unusual movements

•	Preparation of management accounts

•	Month-end management commentary

•	Ensuring reporting is completed accurately and on time



The successful candidate should be capable of independently driving month-end close without needing to be reminded of each task.



3. Budgeting, Forecasting & Cash Flow

•	Prepare and maintain annual budgets

•	Maintain rolling forecasts

•	Prepare and maintain a rolling cash flow forecast

•	Monitor actual results against budget

•	Analyse and explain material variances

•	Identify upcoming cash requirements and potential cash flow risks

•	Monitor working capital

•	Provide management with early warning of potential financial issues

•	Recommend practical actions based on financial results



4. Job Costing & Profitability Analysis



A major responsibility of this role is to establish strong visibility over profitability across the Group.

This includes:

•	Gross profit by client

•	Gross profit by employee

•	Gross profit by team/division

•	Gross profit by business entity

•	Client revenue versus labour cost

•	Actual hours/cost versus client budget

•	Employee utilisation and productivity

•	Revenue and cost per employee

•	Identification of underperforming clients, jobs or service areas

•	Identification of scope creep and cost overruns

•	Development and continuous improvement of job costing methodologies

•	Recommendations to improve margins and operational efficiency



The successful candidate must be able to go beyond producing numbers and explain what the numbers mean, why performance has changed and what management should investigate or change.



5. KPI Dashboard & Performance Reporting



Take ownership of the financial KPI and management reporting framework across the Group.



Responsibilities include:

•	Develop and maintain management KPI dashboards

•	Ensure KPI data is accurate, reconciled and supported by reliable source data

•	Monitor revenue, gross profit and GP%

•	Monitor profitability by client, employee, team and business entity

•	Monitor client budget versus actual hours/cost

•	Monitor employee utilisation and productivity

•	Track budget versus actual performance

•	Monitor cash flow and working capital

•	Monitor accounts receivable and overdue debts

•	Maintain historical KPI trends

•	Identify adverse trends and exceptions requiring management attention

•	Investigate the underlying causes of financial underperformance

•	Provide concise management commentary and recommendations

•	Continuously improve and automate KPI reporting where practical



The objective is to give management timely, accurate and actionable visibility over the financial health and performance of the Group.



This position is expected to highlight problems proactively rather than simply produce reports.



6. Group Finance & Corporate Administration



Take ownership of important recurring financial and administrative obligations, including:

•	Insurance renewals

•	Professional and business licence renewals

•	Registrations and other recurring compliance renewals

•	Finance and loan documentation

•	Subscription and contract renewals

•	Maintaining a centralised renewal and compliance calendar

•	Ensuring deadlines are identified well in advance

•	Obtaining information and quotations where required

•	Maintaining appropriate supporting documentation

•	Escalating matters requiring management approval



An important expectation of this position is that key financial and administrative obligations are proactively managed without relying on the Founder to remember or continually follow them up.



7. Founder / Personal Finance Support



Provide highly confidential financial and administrative support to the Founder, including:

•	Personal cash flow and financial reporting

•	Investment and property-related accounting records

•	Loan and finance schedules

•	Personal financial administration

•	Coordination of information required for tax and financial planning

•	Maintaining accurate records across personal and business financial matters



A very high level of confidentiality, integrity and discretion is essential.



8. Systems, Automation & Continuous Improvement

•	Improve finance processes, controls and reporting systems

•	Reduce unnecessary manual work

•	Identify opportunities for automation

•	Use technology and AI appropriately to improve finance efficiency

•	Ensure automated reports and processes remain accurate and properly controlled

•	Document important finance processes

•	Build scalable finance systems capable of supporting continued Group growth



**What We Are Looking For



The ideal candidate is an experienced all-rounder accountant who can work confidently from detailed transactions through to management-level financial analysis.



You should have:

•	Degree in Accounting, Finance or equivalent

•	CPA/CA qualification or progress towards qualification highly regarded

•	Strong Australian accounting experience

•	Strong management accounting experience

•	Demonstrated experience independently completing month-end close

•	Budgeting and cash flow forecasting experience

•	Strong job costing and profitability analysis skills

•	Advanced Excel skills

•	Strong Xero experience

•	Excellent reconciliation and problem-solving skills

•	Experience working across multiple entities

•	Strong attention to detail

•	Strong written and verbal communication skills

•	Excellent organisational and deadline-management skills

•	High level of confidentiality and professional judgement

•	Ability to work independently with limited supervision



**The Person We Want



We are looking for someone who:

•	Takes ownership rather than waiting for instructions

•	Is naturally organised and follows matters through to completion

•	Notices when numbers do not make sense and investigates why

•	Can move comfortably between detailed accounting and commercial analysis

•	Is willing to remain hands-on

•	Can prioritise effectively in a fast-moving environment

•	Builds systems and controls rather than repeatedly fixing the same problems

•	Is proactive about upcoming deadlines and financial risks

•	Communicates issues early rather than waiting until they become urgent

•	Can respectfully challenge numbers, assumptions and processes

•	Looks continuously for opportunities to automate and improve finance processes

•	Understands that good internal finance is not simply about producing accounts — it is about giving management visibility, control and actionable information



**Key Measures of Success



Success in this position will include:

•	Accurate and timely month-end closing

•	Reliable management accounts

•	Fully reconciled balance sheet accounts

•	Reliable budget versus actual reporting

•	Accurate and regularly maintained cash flow forecasting

•	Clear visibility of gross profit by client, employee, team and business area

•	Reliable KPI dashboards

•	Early identification and escalation of financial risks

•	Strong accounts receivable and working capital visibility

•	No missed insurance, licence or important renewal deadlines

•	Improved finance processes, controls and automation

•	Reduced reliance on the Founder for routine finance administration and follow-up



**The Opportunity

This is an opportunity to take genuine ownership of the internal finance function of a growing Australian business group.

For the right person, the position has significant potential to develop into a broader finance leadership role as the Group continues to grow.

title: AI Forex YouTube Channel Manager
description:
We're looking to hire someone to help us build a successful AI YouTube channel from scratch, covering Forex market analysis. This is part of a growing network of AI channels, and we already run other businesses generating six figures a month, so this isn't a project we're hoping works out. We know the model works, we just need the right person to run it daily and make it their own.



You won't just be an employee here. We'll personally teach you, one on one, how to build a brand from the ground up, the AI tools, the content strategy, all of it, while you earn a real salary and get in early on something with genuinely insane growth potential.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Each day you'll dig into the biggest Forex moves and turn it into a script, using our framework along with your own eye for what actually matters. You'll turn that script into a full video using our AI voice and video tools, no camera and no studio needed. You'll edit it, put together a thumbnail that actually gets clicks, and get it live every single day. You'll jump into the comments to build a real community around the channel, and you're encouraged to pitch your own ideas for hooks and formats, since we're building this together, not just handing you a script to execute.



THE IDEAL CANDIDATE



You're genuinely into Forex or trading, not intimidated by new tools (we'll train you on everything AI, you just need to be quick to pick it up), and you write clean, sharp English. This needs to be your main gig, not something squeezed in between three other jobs. Once you're trained, we trust you to run with it, with weekly check ins and no micromanaging.



REQUIREMENTS



You're available full time and reliable enough that "every single day" actually means every single day, including a rotating weekend day. You'll need a solid internet connection, a quiet spot to record and review audio, and a laptop that can handle basic video editing.



COMPENSATION



Base salary is $1,000 to $1,500 a month depending on experience, plus real performance bonuses on top. We're not a startup hoping to make it one day, we're already running six figure a month businesses, so if this channel takes off, you take off with it.

title: Social Media Strategist and Manager
description:
I run a business and social media is my weakest point. I'm looking for someone to own the content engine behind it — not just scheduling posts, but building the system that turns one filmed video into a full week of distribution across YouTube, Shorts, and Instagram.



This isn't a "post 3x a week" role. Not an ADMIN and definitely not the common social media management. You'll be responsible for making my content land with the exact people I'm trying to reach — and for bringing ideas I haven't thought of yet. What I need are ideas not just following what I want to accomplish.



**What you'll own:**



- **YouTube** — uploads, titles, descriptions, tags, thumbnails, playlists, end screens, channel banners. If you can design thumbnails/banners yourself, that's a big plus (NOT A MUST!)

- **Shorts + Instagram** — daily/weekly posting cadence, hooks, captions, hashtags, trend awareness. You d
 what gets cut and what gets posted.

- **AI-assisted production** — I'll give you a full knowledge base (positioning, offers, voice, past scripts). You'll use AI to draft captions, hooks, angles, and repurposed content that already sounds like me — not starting from scratch every time.

- **Notion** — content calendar, asset library, SOPs, pipeline. Keeping it clean is part of the job.

- **Weekly strategy calls** — you come with numbers: what's working, what's dead, what we should film next.

- **Ideas** — you're expected to bring angles I didn't think of.



**Who you are:**



- You've done B2B marketing — you understand selling to business owners and lead quality over vanity metrics.

- You've also done personal brand marketing — you know a founder-led channel isn't a company page.

- You can hold a strategy conversation without needing to be walked through it.

- You use AI daily and are genuinely good at it — prompting, repurposing, drafting in a specific voice.

- You're organized to the point of being annoying about it.

- You can absorb someone's point of view and write in it — then push it further.



**Nice to have:**

- Thumbnail/banner design (Canva, Figma, Photoshop)

- Basic short-form editing

- Experience marketing an agency, coaching, or staffing-type offer



**Non-negotiable:**

A portfolio. Channels you've run, accounts you've grown, content you made. Real links, real numbers. No portfolio, no interview — no exceptions.



**How to apply:**



Send:

1. Your portfolio — links to channels/accounts you personally ran

2. Two sentences on the biggest growth result you're responsible for, with the numbers

3. A 1–2 minute video/audio introducing yourself.

title: Administrative & Operations Coordinator
description:
Role Overview



We are looking for a proactive, organized, and collaborative Part-Time Virtual Assistant to provide administrative, operational, CRM, and general business support across the organization.



This role will work closely with leadership and different members of the team to help keep priorities organized, tasks moving, and important details from falling through the cracks.



Because this is a highly collaborative and people-focused company, we are looking for someone who genuinely enjoys working as part of a team. The ideal person does not work in isolation or limit themselves only to tasks assigned directly to them. They communicate, participate, share updates, offer help when appropriate, and look for ways to contribute to the team's overall success.



Key Areas of Responsibility

1. Administrative & Operational Support

Manage calendar reminders, appointments, meetings, and scheduling coordination.

Help ensure important commitments, deadlines, and follow-ups are not missed.

Track expenses, manage invoices, and assist with financial report submissions.

Retrieve, organize, and maintain receipts, invoices, and other business documentation.

Assist with travel arrangements, events, meetings, and other business logistics.

Provide general administrative support to keep day-to-day operations organized.

2. CRM Management & Data Organization

Maintain and update the CRM.

Keep contact information, lead records, tags, and other CRM data accurate and organized.

Import, clean, and organize data to improve database quality.

Track leads, follow-ups, tasks, and reminders within the CRM.

Identify opportunities to improve lead tracking, organization, and engagement.

3. Task Coordination & Follow-Through

Take meeting notes and clearly document action items and next steps.

Create and maintain task lists, reminders, calendar invites, and project follow-ups.

Follow through on assigned responsibilities and provide timely updates on progress.

Help ensure tasks do not get lost between meetings, conversations, or different team members.

Coordinate with operations, recruiting, marketing, leadership, and other functions as needed.

4. Reporting & Business Support

Assist with tracking important business metrics and activities.

Help prepare reports and structured updates for leadership.

Monitor information such as leads, activities, projects, and campaign progress.

Keep information organized so leadership and the team have visibility into what is happening.

5. Marketing & Light Creative Support

Assist with content organization, research, and basic marketing activities.

Support social media updates, analytics tracking, and content planning.

Assist with transcription of audio or video content and newsletter preparation when needed.

Conduct research on trends, content ideas, and potential marketing opportunities.

6. Customer & Client Administrative Support

Assist with collecting client feedback and coordinating review requests.

Help identify missing follow-ups or gaps in client communication.

Support administrative activities that contribute to an organized and positive client experience.

7. Cross-Team Collaboration & General Support

Work collaboratively with leadership and different areas of the business rather than operating independently from the team.

Participate in team conversations, meetings, and shared initiatives.

Communicate openly about progress, questions, challenges, and opportunities to help.

Provide administrative support across recruiting, operations, marketing, and leadership without necessarily owning those functions.

Help organize workflows, monitor deliverables, and maintain internal systems.

Step in and support teammates when appropriate and when priorities shift.

Identify inefficiencies and proactively suggest ways to improve processes and teamwork.

What We’re Looking For



The ideal candidate is:



Highly collaborative and team-oriented – enjoys working with people, contributing to conversations, and being part of a shared goal.

Proactive – notices what needs attention and takes initiative instead of always waiting for instructions.

Organized and detail-oriented – able to manage multiple moving pieces without losing track of important details.

Reliable with follow-through – takes ownership of commitments and closes the loop.

Communicative – provides updates, asks questions, and raises concerns early.

Adaptable – comfortable supporting different areas of the business as priorities evolve.

People-focused – understands that relationships and teamwork are just as important as completing individual tasks.

Comfortable with technology – able to learn and work within CRM, project management, communication, and productivity tools.

Success in This Role



Success is not measured only by how many tasks are completed. We are looking for someone who becomes a trusted and engaged member of the team.



The right person will help keep the business organized while also building strong working relationships, communicating consistently, contributing ideas, supporting teammates, and taking shared ownership of the team's success. 



How to Apply

To apply, please submit:

• Updated Resume

• A 60–90 second self-introduction video sharing your digital marketing experience and why you are a strong fit for this role

title: SEO Manager
description:
Reports to: SEO Director 

Location: Remote



Purpose of the Role



The SEO Manager leads a team of SEO specialists while owning day-to-day SEO strategy and execution for a portfolio of dental practices, driving more high-value patients through organic and local search. This is a true people-management role: the SEO Manager sets direction for the executional team, holds them accountable to quality and deadlines, and develops their skills. They turn client goals into clear SEO plans, own the website strategy and information architecture behind organic performance, and build the systems that let the department deliver consistently at scale. They work within the organization's established processes and brand standards, and partner with account, content, and dev teams to deliver measurable growth in leads.

Scope of Ownership

Leadership and performance management of an executional SEO team (specialists/coordinators), including workload, quality, and professional development.

Organic and local SEO performance for assigned dental clients.

Keyword, content, and on-site optimization strategy tied to priority services and locations.

Website strategy and information architecture for new builds, redesigns, and ongoing site improvements — sitemap and service-page structure, URL hierarchy, internal linking, redirects, migrations, page prioritization, and final SEO QA before and after launch.

Local search presence (Google Business Profile, citations, reviews) for each practice.

SEO reporting and insights that support client retention and upsell opportunities.

The SEO delivery system — the workflows, templates, QA checkpoints, automation, capacity planning, and documentation the department runs on.

Consistent application of the organization's SEO methodology, brand guidelines, and documented processes across the team.



Core Responsibilities

1. Team Leadership & Management

Lead, mentor, and manage a team of SEO specialists—setting clear priorities, assigning work, and ensuring deadlines and quality standards are met.

Hold the team accountable for executional output, reviewing work and giving direct, constructive feedback that raises the standard over time.

Develop the team's capabilities through coaching, training, and regular one-on-ones; identify skill gaps and close them.

Manage capacity and workload across the team to balance client demands with realistic delivery.

Own team performance against client outcomes, treating missed deadlines or quality issues as the manager's responsibility to resolve.

2. Strategy & Planning

Build and maintain SEO strategies and roadmaps for each client based on goals, competition, and budget.

Conduct keyword, SERP, and competitor research to prioritize high-value opportunities (implants, ortho, cosmetic, emergencies, etc.).

3. Website Strategy & Information Architecture

Own the SEO strategy behind new websites, redesigns, and ongoing site improvements—translating client goals and search demand into a site structure that ranks and converts.

Plan sitemaps and service-page structure, including how services, procedures, and locations are grouped, nested, and prioritized.

Define URL hierarchy and naming conventions, and maintain them as sites grow.

Design and maintain internal linking architecture that distributes authority to priority pages and supports topical coverage.

Plan and QA redirects and site migrations—mapping old to new, protecting rankings and traffic, and validating post-launch.

Prioritize pages for build and optimization based on search demand, revenue potential, and competitive opportunity.

Run final SEO QA before launch and after go-live (indexation, metadata, headings, schema, internal links, redirects, tracking), and document what shipped.

Partner with design, content, and dev on execution in WordPress, working from a clear SEO spec rather than reacting after the build.

4. On-Page & Technical SEO

Perform SEO audits and implement on-page optimizations (metadata, headings, copy, internal links, schema).

Identify technical issues (indexing, speed, mobile, CWV) and coordinate fixes with dev/WordPress support.

5. Local SEO for Dental Practices

Optimize and maintain Google Business Profiles (categories, services, posts, photos, tracking).

Oversee citations/NAP consistency and advise on review generation and reputation strategies.

6. Content & Collaboration

Create SEO briefs and outlines for new and updated content (service pages, blogs, FAQs, location pages); briefs are informed by SERP analysis and search intent, not just keywords.

QA content for SEO best practices before and after publishing, ensuring proper on-page optimization.

7. Reporting & Optimization

Build and maintain dashboards and monthly reports (traffic, rankings, GBP metrics, leads).

Analyze performance, surface insights, and propose clear next-step optimizations.

Join client calls as the SEO voice, explaining results and recommendations in plain language.

8. Process, Systems & Documentation

Follow, enforce, and improve the organization's SEO checklists, templates, SOPs, and brand guidelines—ensuring the team works the same way to the same standard.

Build and improve scalable workflows across the SEO department so quality holds as client volume grows, rather than depending on individual memory or heroics.

Create and maintain templates, checklists, and QA systems that make the right output the default and catch issues before they reach a client.

Identify repetitive work and introduce automation or tooling to remove it, freeing the team for strategy and execution that needs a human.

Own capacity planning for the department—forecasting workload against team availability, flagging constraints early, and proposing solutions before delivery slips.

Document processes, decisions, and standards so the department is transferable, trainable, and not dependent on any one person.

Take ownership of the delivery system end to end, so day-to-day monitoring, chasing, and follow-up do not need to come from leadership.

Ensure all client-facing and on-site work adheres to organizational guidelines, brand voice, and compliance requirements before it ships.

Train account and junior team members on SEO basics relevant to their roles.

Support the team's day-to-day work by assisting with research, implementation guidance, QA, and documentation as needed to unblock work and keep projects moving.



Success Metrics / KPIs

Success in this role is built on consistent execution across five core areas: daily and weekly task ownership, accurate and descriptive time tracking, proactive capacity management, timely follow-up without being prompted, and thorough QA before work moves forward. We value team members who take pride in the details and hold themselves accountable to a high standard before anyone else has to ask.

Growth in organic traffic and organic new patient leads for assigned clients.

Improved rankings and visibility for priority keywords and local searches in target markets.

Increased GBP engagement (calls, website clicks, direction requests) and stable/improved local pack presence.

On-time completion of SEO deliverables by the team (audits, optimizations, briefs, reports).

Website launches and migrations that protect or improve organic performance, with SEO QA completed before and after go-live.

Team performance, growth, and retention—measured by quality of output, adherence to process, and individual development.

Measurable improvement in the SEO delivery system—documented workflows, working templates and QA checkpoints, reduced rework, and less day-to-day follow-up required from leadership.

Consistent adherence to organizational guidelines and brand standards across all team output.

Positive internal and client feedback on clarity of communication and strategic value.



Required Skills & Experience

Must have reliable and stable internet connection

Must be able and willing to work 8am - 12pm EST Monday - Friday to overlap with US team; other 4 hours per day can be completed at your convenience

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, as this role writes client-facing deliverables, joins client calls as the SEO voice, and documents processes for the department.

3–5 years of hands-on SEO experience, preferably in an agency or lead-generation environment.

At least 2+ years directly managing or leading an executional team, with demonstrated ability to assign work, hold people accountable, and develop performance.

Experience planning websites and website improvements from an SEO perspective—sitemap and service-page structure, URL hierarchy, internal linking, redirects, migrations, page prioritization, and final SEO QA.

Demonstrated experience building or improving team processes—workflows, templates, QA systems, documentation, or automation—not just working inside processes someone else built.

Proven ability to work within an organization's established processes, brand standards, and guidelines—and to hold a team to them consistently.

Demonstrated success with local SEO for service businesses (healthcare, dental, home services, or similar).

Strong understanding of semantic SEO, including search intent, topical coverage, internal linking strategy, and content structure aligned with modern SERPs.

Proficiency with Google Search Console, GA4, a keyword research tool, a site crawler, and a rank tracker.

Working knowledge of WordPress (Elementor or similar) and basic HTML best practices, with enough site-level ownership to spec and QA structural changes rather than only requesting them.

Experience with capacity planning or workload forecasting across a team.

Strong analytical skills and comfort turning data into clear, practical recommendations.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Familiarity with content optimization tools such as SurferSEO, 
, NeuronWriter, or similar platforms.



Required Leadership Behaviors

As SEO Manager you will balance team leadership with direct execution. This means personally jumping into audits, GBP work, on-page optimization, content briefs, internal linking, reporting, and QA alongside managing and developing the team around you. Given the scale of our client portfolio, the right person thrives in a high-volume environment, takes ownership of the delivery system, and keeps things moving without needing direction at every step.

Manages and develops people: Leads an executional team directly—sets clear expectations, gives honest feedback, and grows the people on the team.

Builds the system, not just the output: Improves how the work gets done—workflows, templates, QA, automation, documentation—so quality scales with volume.

Follows and upholds guidelines: Works within the organization's processes and brand standards, and ensures the team does the same; sees consistency as a strength, not a constraint.

Ownership: Takes responsibility for SEO outcomes, website performance, and team delivery on assigned accounts; reliably follows through.

Collaborative: Partners with account, content, design, and dev to move work forward without friction, and removes blockers for the team.

Proactive: Spots issues and opportunities early and brings forward solutions, not just problems.

Client-friendly communicator: Explains SEO concepts and results in a way that builds trust and understanding.

Growth-oriented: Keeps up with SEO and local search changes and looks for ways to improve client and agency performance.

Models accountability: Owns results, follows through on commitments, and addresses issues directly instead of deflecting or blaming.

Builds trust: Approachable, transparent, and willing to admit mistakes—then leads the way on solutions.

Energizes a remote team: Brings positivity through engaging meetings, creative rituals, and inclusive activities that make work feel fun, not flat.



Nice to Haves

Experience designing or using SEO automation workflows (e.g., for content production, internal linking, reporting, or local SEO tasks).

Experience leading or supporting a website migration or large-scale redesign from the SEO side.

Open and curious mindset toward testing and adopting AI- and automation-powered tools to improve content quality, efficiency, and SEO performance.

title: Website Conversion Copywriter
description:
If you’re a talented copywriter who specialises in writing persuasive, conversion-focused copy for websites and landing pages, while also helping our clients get found in search and LLMs, and you’re looking for a secure, long-term full-time position, this could be the perfect role for you.



You’ll work from the comfort of your own home, writing conversion-focused website copy for clients across a wide variety of industries.



We are 
, an Australian-based branding and website agency that has designed over 2,000 websites.



Our main focus is writing copy that connects with the target audience and converts visitors into leads and customers. We also want our copy to be optimised for search and structured so our clients and their expertise can be discovered and cited by LLMs.



You do not need to be an SEO or AI search expert. Conversion copywriting comes first. We’ve created our own Claude Skills to help with SEO, content optimisation, AEO, and GEO, so you’ll have AI-powered tools and frameworks to guide you through that part of the process.



By joining our team, you’ll get to:

-  Write compelling, conversion-focused copy for websites and landing pages.

-  Research our clients, their ideal customers, competitors, positioning, and offers.

-  Apply proven frameworks such as PIASA, SPIN Selling, Building a StoryBrand, and Robert Cialdini’s principles of persuasion.

-  Write copy with SEO, search intent, and AI visibility in mind.

-  Use AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude to improve your research and writing process, without producing generic AI-sounding copy.

-  Work with a friendly Filipino team led by a supportive Australian management team.

-  Work with a wide variety of international clients and industries.

-  Have a steady income paid weekly in PHP directly into your bank account via Wise.



Here’s what we’re looking for:

-  Proven experience writing conversion-focused website and landing page copy.

-  Excellent research skills and a strong understanding of customer psychology.

-  The ability to write clear, concise, persuasive copy that gets attention, communicates value, and encourages action.

-  Experience with proven copywriting frameworks and persuasion principles.

-  A good understanding of SEO, search intent, and content optimisation.

-  An understanding of, or strong interest in, AI visibility, AEO, and GEO, including how content can be discovered and cited by LLMs.

-  Experience using AI tools as part of your research and copywriting workflow.

-  Excellent written and spoken English.

-  The ability to manage multiple projects, collaborate with our team, and respond well to constructive feedback.



You will need to:

-  Be self-motivated, organised, and reliable.

-  Work at a reasonably fast pace while maintaining a high standard of work.

-  Work full-time on weekdays within standard business hours.

-  Be available for Zoom calls with our team and occasional client calls.

-  Have a fast and reliable computer and internet connection.

-  Be looking for a long-term position and ideally aim to work with us for at least two years.

-  Be ethical, dependable, a team player, and a good communicator.



Role Details

-  Full-time, 40 hours per week

-  Remote, Philippines only

-  Monday to Friday

-  Competitive salary

-  Paid weekly in PHP via Wise

-  Fully paid 4-week trial

-  Long-term position

-  Supportive, forward-thinking team



About Studio1

-  Studio1 is an Australian-based branding and website agency. We’ve designed over 2,000 websites and specialise in creating strategic, conversion-focused websites that help our clients grow.

-  We embrace AI and new technology to continually improve the way we research, strategise, write, design, and build websites.

-  Our core values are Results, Creativity, Innovation, and Continuous Improvement.



To apply, please send: 

-  Your CV

-  Examples of website and landing page copy you’ve written, preferably links to live websites

-  And briefly answer:

    -  How do you use AI in your copywriting workflow?

    -  What makes website copy convert?

    -  How do you approach SEO when writing website copy?

    -  What do you know about writing content that can be discovered and cited by LLMs?



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to an interview.



If hired, you’ll begin with a fully paid 4-week trial.



Good luck =)

title: Google Sheets Data Architect & Dashboard Specialist
description:
We are looking for a highly skilled Google Sheets Data Architect / Dashboard Specialist to manage, improve, and troubleshoot multiple business dashboards.



Our dashboards pull data from a CRM and other sources. Some information is automatically imported, while other data is manually entered. You will be responsible for maintaining clean data architecture, ensuring reporting accuracy, improving performance, and resolving issues when data or formulas break.



Key Responsibilities

- Architect and maintain complex Google Sheets systems

- Manage data flow from raw data → processing → dashboards

- Build and improve dashboards using QUERY, pivot tables, charts, slicers, filters, and dropdowns

- Write, troubleshoot, and optimize advanced formulas

- Maintain data pulled automatically from CRM systems and manually entered datasets

- Identify missing, incorrect, duplicated, or mismatched data

- Improve spreadsheet speed and reduce unnecessary calculations

- Maintain data validation, protected ranges, helper sheets, and named ranges

- Document formulas, dependencies, data sources, and reporting logic

- Troubleshoot reporting discrepancies independently

- Maintain and improve automated data workflows 



Required Skills

You must have advanced/expert-level Google Sheets experience, including strong knowledge of:



Functions:

QUERY, FILTER, XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, IMPORTRANGE, ARRAYFORMULA, UNIQUE, SORT, SEQUENCE, SUMIFS, COUNTIFS, AVERAGEIFS, IF/IFS, IFERROR, REGEX functions, TEXT functions, and date/time formulas.



You should also understand:



- Spreadsheet architecture and normalized data structures

- Dashboard development

- Large-dataset performance optimization

- Data validation and quality control

- CRM-to-Google Sheets data workflows

- Advanced troubleshooting and formula debugging

- SOP and technical documentation



- Additional Skills

Experience with the following is strongly preferred:



ChatGPT / AI tools for formula development, analysis, automation, and documentation


 for integrations, webhooks, and automated workflows

Apify for web scraping and external data ingestion

APIs, automation pipelines, pagination, rate limits, and data normalization



You must be comfortable using AI to work faster while still independently validating all formulas, logic, and outputs.



Non-Negotiable Work Requirements



You must be willing to:



Use a time-tracking application during your working hours

Remain connected to a Zoom breakout room during your scheduled shift



If you are not comfortable with either requirement, please do not apply.



Application Instruction — Read Carefully



To confirm that you read the entire job posting, start your application with the exact phrase: “DATA ARCHITECT – DASHBOARD READY.”



Then, in 3–5 sentences, describe the most complex Google Sheets dashboard or data system you have built and mention at least three advanced Google Sheets functions you used.



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered.

title: Strategic Executive Assistant (Creative, Organized & High Ownership)
description:
Who We Are:

We are CL Financial (CLFIN . ca), a Toronto-based financial services firm serving families across Ontario and Alberta, with a strong presence in the Filipino community in Canada. We've been around since 2012 and are now in an exciting stage of growth: building new technology, training programs, internal systems, and infrastructure to support where the company is going next.



We're a lean team with ambitious plans, and we care about doing things well: clean systems, clear communication, strong design, and thoughtful execution.



We're not trying to become a huge corporate machine. We want to stay lean, move quickly, and have really capable people doing meaningful work.



About the Role:

We're looking for a Strategic Executive Assistant to work closely with our COO across creative, operational, and strategic projects.



This isn't a traditional VA role where you'll simply be handed a checklist every morning and told what to do. Sometimes you'll get a clear assignment. Other times, you'll get a rough idea, a voice note, or a half-formed concept and need to help turn it into something useful, organized, and polished. That's a big part of the job.



This will start as a part-time role, with the opportunity to transition into a full-time position after the first few months if it's a strong mutual fit. Ideally, we're looking for someone who wants to grow with us long-term.



One other thing, you don't need to come from finance, although you should be interested in learning it. This is an industry where expertise matters, and the better you understand our business, our advisors, and our clients, the better you'll become at this role. We'll help you learn, but you should genuinely want to.



What You'll Do:

Project Support:

- Organize projects, priorities, meetings, and follow-ups

- Coordinate with team members, contractors, and developers

- Help make sure things don't quietly fall through the cracks



Creative & Communication:

- Create beautifully designed presentations, one-pagers, training materials, internal communications, and visual assets

- Turn rough notes or concepts into polished outputs

- Help maintain consistency across our brand and internal tools

- Look at something we've created and tell us, honestly, "this could be better"



Systems & Operations:

- Maintain daily spreadsheets, trackers, dashboards, and project pipelines

- Test new internal tools and identify improvements

- Find ways to simplify or automate repetitive work



AI & Technology:

- Use tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Canva, and Google Workspace to research, create, and improve work

- Experiment with new tools and figure things out quickly

- Help us find smarter ways to work as new technology becomes available



You don't need to know every tool already. Being resourceful and learning quickly matters much more.



Who We're Looking For:

You'll probably thrive here if you:

- Have excellent written English

- Are highly organized and dependable

- Have strong visual/design taste (this is more important than I'm probably letting on in this posting)

- Can work independently without needing constant direction

- Learn new tools quickly

- Can manage multiple projects without losing the details

- Are comfortable receiving direct feedback

- Naturally look for better ways to do things

- Have high integrity and are comfortable being transparent (this is also more important than I’m probably letting on in this posting)



Above everything else, we're looking for judgment, initiative, and ownership. We don't expect you to know everything. We do expect you to think, ask good questions, and care about getting to the right outcome.



Why Work With Us?

- Direct exposure to company leadership and decision-making

- Meaningful projects alongside the more traditional VA work

- Creative freedom; good ideas are genuinely encouraged

- Opportunity to learn AI, technology, operations, and business

- Increasing responsibility as your capabilities grow

- A real pathway from part-time into a full-time role

- A stable company with ambitious long-term growth plans

- A predominantly Filipino team and client community (99% of the company and clients come from a Filipino background)

- The chance to actually see your work shape how a company operates (for real)



How to Apply:

If you've made it this far, include the word "builder" somewhere in the first sentence of your application so we know you actually read the posting.



Please include:

1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Why this role caught your attention

3. Your answer to this question: What does the best boss you've ever worked with do that brings out your best work? And what does a manager do that makes it harder for you to perform?



We're not necessarily looking for the person with the longest resume. We're looking for someone smart, creative, trustworthy, and hungry to become exceptionally good at what they do. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: eCommerce Supply Chain Manager (Amazon FBA & D2C)
description:
## READ THIS FIRST ##



We're a fast-growing 7-figure car-care brand from Germany, selling mostly on Amazon (FBA) across the EU plus our own D2C store. Our founder has run the entire supply chain himself until now — we're handing it over. You'll become the person who owns our daily supply chain operations.



This is a real ownership role, not a task list for a junior VA — but it's also hands-on, brand-side operations for OUR OWN Amazon business. Not agency, consulting, or client-support supply chain, and not a role where you manage a team: you own the work and do it yourself.



We're moving onto professional inventory-planning software that handles the heavy calculations, so a big part of the job is running the process, checking the outputs, and executing — reliably and independently. You'll still use spreadsheets here and there and handle plenty of work outside the tool, so you need to be comfortable with numbers and data — but you won't be building complex spreadsheet models.



APPLY ONLY IF ALL OF THESE ARE TRUE:

- 3+ years in e-commerce supply chain / inventory management, in FULL-TIME roles

- Hands-on AMAZON FBA & SELLER CENTRAL experience at a sizeable seller / brand doing SEVERAL MILLION+ in annual revenue, in a full-time role

- You've operated an inventory planning / replenishment tool (Inventory Planner, SoStocked, or similar) OR a large ERP like SAP / Oracle

- Excellent written English

- Detail-oriented, structured, and comfortable working with numbers and data

- Happy as a hands-on individual contributor who owns the work end-to-end — this is NOT a team-lead role

- A stable, high-speed internet connection reliable enough for daily video calls, and a quiet, focused place to work

- Available full-time, long-term, with at least a few hours of daily overlap with German business hours (CET)



If that's you, read on.





## ABOUT US ##



A German premium car-care brand with ~200 SKUs. ~80% of sales run through Amazon (FBA) with additional bundles via a 3PL; ~20% through our own online store. We're a small, focused team, and we're expanding into new EU marketplaces over the next 12 months. We use AI tools for data aggregation and the repetitive work — but the smart decisions stay with the human running the process. That'll be you.





## THE ROLE ##



You'll be the daily operator of our inventory-planning tool and own the process end-to-end. Onboarding is hands-on and directly from the founder. We're still building out our SOPs, so you'll help document and improve the processes as we go — you should enjoy creating structure, not just following it. Once you're up to speed, you run it yourself and escalate decisions back to the founder if needed.





## WHAT YOU'LL DO ##



- Demand forecasting: review and maintain SKU-level forecasts (seasonal products), apply manual overrides for promotions, growth, and new launches

- Purchasing: turn replenishment recommendations into POs to suppliers in Asia and Europe

- Component planning: ensure components we supply to our contract manufacturers ship on time for scheduled production

- Amazon FBA replenishment: review/approve weekly FBA transfers per marketplace, create and finalize shipments in Seller Central, monitor inbound

- PO tracking: monitor open POs, keep landed-cost and payment data current, export payment data for finance

- Stock monitoring: watch coverage and stockout / overstock risk across all locations (FBA EU, 3PL, manufacturer) 

- Master data: keep lead times, MOQs, costs, weights/volumes, BOMs accurate

- Communication: coordinate with suppliers, manufacturers, and our 3PL — mostly in English. A few suppliers may communicate partly in German; we'll support that with AI translation, so German is not required.





## WHAT WE OFFER ##



- $1,500–1,800 USD / month, based on experience — full-time, long-term

- 100% remote, flexible hours, no graveyard shift (some overlap with CET)

- Direct collaboration with the founder, real ownership, and modern tools

- Hands-on onboarding from the founder, and the freedom to shape our processes as we build them out

- Paid time off, long-term stability, room to grow as the brand expands

- Start date: asap 2026





## HOW TO APPLY ##



To show us you read the whole post, START YOUR APPLICATION WITH THE WORD: STOCK-READY



Then answer these briefly:



1. For which Amazon seller(s) did you handle supply chain / inventory — roughly how many SKUs, what annual revenue, and was it a full-time role?

2. Describe one supply chain decision you made ENTIRELY ON YOUR OWN that went beyond routine execution. What did you d
, and what was the outcome?

3. Which inventory planning / replenishment tools or ERPs have you operated, and for how long? Also: your written English level, earliest possible start date, and expected monthly salary.

4. Confirm your work setup: how reliable is your internet for daily video calls (rough speed / any backup), and is your workspace quiet and free of distractions?



Attach your updated CV. Applications that don't start with the codeword, or that skip the questions, won't be considered.



Thank you for your interest!

Jonas

title: AI Systems & Automation Engineer
description:
AI Systems & Automation Engineer — Build Our AI Workforce



About the Role



We are looking for a highly skilled AI Systems & Automation Engineer to help us design, build, and continuously improve an AI-powered operating system across our businesses.



This is NOT a basic VA position.



This is NOT simply a Zapier or ChatGPT position.



We are looking for someone who understands AI agents, automation, APIs, integrations, business processes, and systems architecture and can use those skills to make our companies more efficient.



Our goal is to build an AI workforce—AI agents and automated systems that work alongside our human team, eliminate unnecessary manual work, connect our applications, improve accountability, and allow our companies to scale more efficiently.



What You’ll Be Responsible For



You will help us:



• Build AI agents/“AI employees” capable of performing specific business functions



• Connect multiple applications so information flows seamlessly throughout the organization



• Build advanced automations using tools such as n8n, Make, Zapier, APIs, and webhooks



• Integrate AI models such as OpenAI and Claude into our business workflows



• Build systems that can analyze information, make decisions based on defined rules, take approved actions, and escalate situations to humans when necessary



• Integrate AI and automation with our CRM, especially GoHighLevel



• Create automated reporting and KPI systems



• Build databases and knowledge systems that AI agents can access



• Build internal AI assistants that understand our SOPs, processes, training, and company knowledge



• Monitor automations and identify failures before they become larger business problems



• Troubleshoot, maintain, and continuously improve existing automations



• Document systems so they are understandable and maintainable



VERY IMPORTANT: You Must Be Proactive



We are NOT looking for someone who waits for us to identify every automation that needs to be built.



A major responsibility of this position will be to learn our business and proactively identify where AI and automation can improve it.



You should be able to study our departments, workflows, software, and processes and tell us:



“You’re currently using three people and five manual steps to accomplish this. We can automate 70% of this process, connect these systems, and have an AI agent handle these responsibilities.”



You will be expected to:



• Audit existing workflows and technology



• Identify repetitive manual work



• Identify bottlenecks between departments



• Identify areas where information is being entered multiple times



• Identify where applications should be connected



• Recommend where AI agents could replace, assist, or enhance existing processes



• Recommend new AI tools and technologies when appropriate



• Estimate potential time and cost savings



• Prioritize projects based on business impact



• Build the approved solutions



• Measure whether the automation actually improved the business



We want someone who doesn’t just ask:



“What do you want me to build?”



We want someone who also asks:



“Why are you doing it this way, and is there a better way to accomplish this with AI?”



Examples of AI Employees We Want to Build



Some potential projects include:



AI Operations Assistant

Monitors workflows, deadlines, assignments, and incomplete tasks and alerts leadership when something requires attention.



AI Reporting & KPI Analyst

Pulls information from multiple systems, analyzes performance, identifies trends/problems, and automatically provides management reports.



AI Lead Qualification Agent

Analyzes incoming leads, scores them, updates the CRM, assigns them appropriately, and initiates the correct follow-up process.



AI Follow-Up Agent

Tracks leads and tasks and automatically triggers appropriate follow-up when action has not occurred.



AI Recruiting Assistant

Helps screen applicants, analyze qualifications, organize candidates, schedule interviews, and maintain recruiting pipelines.



AI Marketing Analyst

Analyzes marketing data across platforms and identifies performance trends, opportunities, and potential problems.



AI Quality-Control Agent

Reviews processes, records, or completed work against established standards and flags potential issues for human review.



AI Knowledge Assistant

Allows employees to ask questions and receive answers based on our company’s SOPs, training, policies, and internal knowledge.



These are examples. We expect the person in this position to identify additional opportunities.



Required Skills



Strong experience with:



• n8n — HIGHLY preferred

• GoHighLevel (GHL)

• OpenAI API / ChatGPT

• Claude / Anthropic API

• 
 and/or Zapier

• REST APIs

• Webhooks

• JSON

• OAuth / API authentication

• Python and/or JavaScript

• Databases and data management

• Error handling, monitoring, and troubleshooting



Strongly Preferred Experience



Experience with some of the following is a major advantage:



• AI Agents / Agentic Workflows

• RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)

• Supabase

• PostgreSQL

• Airtable

• Vector databases

• Pinecone / Qdrant / pgvector

• MCP

• Voice AI

• Vapi

• Retell AI

• ElevenLabs

• Twilio

• AI knowledge bases

• Prompt engineering

• CRM architecture

• Automated dashboards/reporting

• Human-in-the-loop AI systems



You do NOT need to know every tool listed above.



We care more about your ability to understand a business problem, design the right solution, and figure out how to build it.



The Type of Person We’re Looking For



The ideal candidate is:



Part AI Automation Engineer

Part Systems Architect

Part Business Process Consultant



You should be naturally curious and constantly looking for ways to make systems better.



We want someone who thinks:



“There has to be a better way to do this.”



Then figures out how to build it.



How to Apply



Please do NOT send us a generic application.



Start your application with the words:



“AI WORKFORCE”



Then answer the following:



1. What is the most sophisticated AI or automation system you have personally built?



Explain what it did, what applications were connected, and what business problem it solved.



2. What is your experience with n8n?



Please rate yourself from 1–10 and explain why.



3. What is your experience with APIs and webhooks?



Give us an example of an integration you built that required working directly with an API.



4. What experience do you have with GoHighLevel?



5. Tell us about an automation you built that broke after being deployed.



How did you discover the problem, what caused it, and what did you change so it wouldn’t happen again?



6. Give us an example of a business process where YOU identified the opportunity to automate it rather than the company telling you exactly what to build.



This question is extremely important to us.



REQUIRED: Loom Video



Please submit a 3–5 minute Loom video showing us an actual AI or automation system you personally built.



Do not just describe it.



Share your screen and show us:



• The workflow

• The applications being connected

• The automation logic

• Where AI is being used

• How data moves through the system

• How errors/failures are handled

• What business problem the system solved



Applications without a Loom demonstration may not be considered.



Final Challenge



At the end of your application, briefly explain how you would approach this scenario:



We receive leads from multiple marketing sources into GoHighLevel.



We want AI to analyze and score each lead, determine which team member should receive the lead, update the CRM, assign the lead, trigger the appropriate communication, track whether the assigned person follows up, automatically initiate additional follow-up when appropriate, and provide management with reporting showing lead source, appointments, conversions, team performance, and potential problems.



Do not build it. Simply explain how you would architect the system.



We’re not looking for someone who simply knows AI tools.



We’re looking for someone who can help us build the AI infrastructure that makes our entire company operate better.

title: Amazon PPC Ads Associate
description:
About Hakkawise:



Hakkawise is a multi-brand consumer goods group. We acquire and grow a portfolio of consumer brands that sell across Amazon (UK & US), our own D2C stores, and B2B wholesale. Amazon is a core channel for u and paid advertising is how we win visibility, drive rank, and grow profitably. This role owns the performance and profitability of our Amazon ad spend across the portfolio.



The Role:



We're looking for an analytical, results-driven Amazon PPC Ads Associate to manage and optimise our Sponsored Ads campaigns across multiple brands and marketplaces. You'll own keyword strategy, bids, and budgets balancing growth against profitability and turn advertising data into clear decisions and reporting. This is a hands-on role with direct, measurable impact on sales, rank, and margin.



What You'll Do:



• Manage Amazon Sponsored Ads campaigns: Sponsored Products, Brands, and Display across brands and marketplaces (UK & US), from build to ongoing optimisation.

• Own keyword and targeting strategy: researching and refining keywords and ASIN targeting using Search Query Performance, Top Search Terms, and other data.

• Optimise bids and budgets: managing spend to hit ACoS / TACoS / ROAS targets while protecting rank and share of voice.

• Support new product launches: building launch ad strategies that drive early velocity and organic rank.

• Report on performance: tracking spend, sales, ACoS/TACoS, and organic share, and surfacing clear insights and recommendations.

• Manage advertising data and tooling: keeping campaign data accurate and building trackers that make performance visible to the team.



What We're Looking For:



• Hands-on experience managing Amazon PPC / Sponsored Ads campaigns (Seller Central), ideally across multiple products or brands.

• Strong grasp of Amazon ad metrics and economics — ACoS, TACoS, ROAS, CPC, and conversion — and how they trade off.

• Strong analytical skills and Excel/Google Sheets fluency (formulas, pivot tables) to interpret data and drive decisions.

• Solid keyword research skills and understanding of how paid and organic rank interact.

• Excellent attention to detail and comfort managing spend responsibly against clear targets.

• Proactive and self-directed; you spot and act on opportunities and problems early.



Nice to Have:



• Experience across multiple brands, marketplaces (UK & US), or consumer goods categories.

• Familiarity with Amazon advertising and analytics tools (e.g. Helium 10, sellerboard, Amazon Marketing Stream).

• Understanding of the wider Amazon growth picture — listings, content, and reviews — and how they affect ad performance.

• Experience supporting product launches on Amazon.



Why Join:



You'll own a meaningful advertising budget across a growing portfolio of brands, see your work move rank, revenue, and margin directly, and have the freedom to build and optimise our Amazon ads engine in a fast-moving, multi-brand business.

Work Australian hours (only 2 hour timezone difference with the Philippines).

title: Short-Form Video Editor & Social Media Manager (Instagram / TikTok / YouTube) - Ongoing, UK Land & Build Project
description:

I'm building a content series documenting a land, building and lifestyle project in the UK - construction, rewilding, and converting outbuildings into holiday lets.



You can see the current accounts here:

- 

-
