title: Customer Service Representative
description:
About the Role



We are looking for a Customer Service Representative to serve as a key point of contact for customers, vendors, subcontractors, and other business contacts.



This role is heavily focused on professional phone communication, outbound calling, follow-up, and relationship-building. You will make and receive calls, communicate information clearly, gather the necessary details, and ensure requests and conversations are followed through to completion.



The ideal candidate is confident on the phone, easy to understand, personable, proactive, and comfortable working independently. This person should be able to build rapport quickly without sounding scripted and represent the company professionally in every interaction.



Key Responsibilities

Handle inbound and outbound calls with customers, vendors, subcontractors, and other business contacts

Make outbound calls to subcontractors and business contacts to introduce opportunities and gather information

Clearly explain the purpose of each call and communicate company information in a natural, conversational manner

Build rapport and establish trust quickly, particularly during outbound calls

Collect and accurately document contact information,
 addresses, availability, pricing, scope-related information, and other required details

Respond to customer, vendor, and subcontractor questions by phone and

Follow up consistently on requests, questions, scheduling, documents, pricing, and other outstanding items

Monitor incoming
s and ensure timely, professional responses

Maintain accurate records of calls, conversations, requests, contacts, and follow-ups

Handle routine questions and issues independently and escalate matters when appropriate

Keep the owner informed of important issues, updates, opportunities, and unresolved matters

Develop a strong working knowledge of the company's processes, services, common questions, and day-to-day operations

Use provided scripts, talking points, and processes as guides while keeping conversations natural and personalized

Use Hubstaff to accurately track working hours and maintain required time-tracking and productivity records

Remain available and responsive during scheduled working hours

Perform other customer service and administrative duties as needed



Requirements

Excellent spoken and written English

Clear, easy-to-understand speech and strong verbal communication skills

Confident, professional, and personable phone presence

Comfortable making frequent outbound calls

Strong listening and comprehension skills

Ability to explain information clearly and adjust communication based on the person being contacted

Strong rapport-building and interpersonal skills

Strong organization, follow-up, and attention to detail

Ability to manage multiple conversations, requests, and follow-ups

Proactive, dependable, and able to work independently

Strong problem-solving and judgment skills

Comfortable learning new systems, processes, and industry terminology

Comfortable working remotely and adapting to new tools, workflows, and client processes

Reliable equipment and a professional-quality headset and internet connection

Willingness to use Hubstaff consistently during working hours in accordance with company and client requirements

Strong commitment to the role, schedule, and assigned responsibilities



Preferred Qualifications

Previous customer service, call-handling, or outbound calling experience

Experience communicating with vendors, subcontractors, suppliers, or other business contacts

Experience supporting a U.S.-based company

Experience with phone systems or cloud-based dialers

Experience working with Hubstaff or similar time-tracking/productivity platforms

Construction or contractor industry experience is a plus, but not required

Conversational Spanish is a plus, but not required



Candidate Evaluation Areas



Candidates may be evaluated based on the following:



Relevant Work Experience – Demonstrated experience relevant to customer service, phone handling, outbound calling, or administrative support

Software & Technical Proficiency – Ability to use common business software, communication platforms, phone systems, and other required tools

Remote Work Experience & Adaptability – Ability to work effectively in a remote environment and adapt to different clients, systems, and processes

English Proficiency (Spoken & Written) – Ability to communicate clearly, professionally, and confidently in English

Professionalism & Attitude – Professional demeanor, positive attitude, maturity, and ability to represent the client appropriately

Response Time & Clarity – Responsiveness and ability to provide clear, concise, and understandable communication

Internet & Work Setup – Reliable internet, appropriate equipment, professional workspace, and call-ready setup

Commitment to Role & Availability – Ability to consistently meet the required schedule and remain available during working hours

Time Management & Dependability – Ability to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, follow through, and reliably manage assigned responsibilities

Problem-Solving Skills – Ability to assess routine issues, determine appropriate next steps, and escalate matters when necessary

Willingness to Learn & Adapt – Ability and willingness to learn the client's business, industry terminology, systems, and processes



What Success Looks Like



The ideal candidate will become a dependable first point of contact for the business, someone who can confidently pick up the phone, have a natural conversation, communicate information clearly, build trust quickly, gather the right information, and consistently follow through.



Success in this role is not about simply reading a script. It's about being understood, sounding confident and professional, making the person on the other end comfortable, and moving the conversation toward the desired outcome.



The right person will be able to take ownership of routine communication so the owner can stay focused on higher-value business activities without having to manage every call, question, or follow-up.



To apply:



Complete the application form.

Upload your updated CV.

Submit your short introduction video.



Apply Here –

title: Media Buyer Native Ads
description:
EVOLVE Digital is a performance marketing and e-commerce agency based in Germany (Osnabrück), working with a fully remote, international team. We're looking for an experienced media buyer with a strong track record in scaling native ad accounts.



What you'll do

Independently manage our Taboola and Outbrain campaigns according to existing SOPs

Handle daily budget, bid, publisher, and placement management, including blocklist maintenance

Make data-driven scaling decisions — knowing when an account can handle more budget without hurting margin

Build and run systematic testing on angles, creatives, thumbnails, and offer pages

Analyze performance by device, time of day, placement, and publisher, and translate findings into action

Brief copywriting and design based on data and a clear hypothesis

Document tests, decisions, and results clearly enough for another buyer to take over



What you bring

Proven track record of scaling native ad accounts from five- to six-figure monthly budgets

Several years of consistent, hands-on experience specifically with Taboola and/or Outbrain

E-commerce/D2C experience

Solid understanding of tracking/attribution and direct-response funnels (advertorial, pre-lander, offer page)

Disciplined, self-directed work following SOPs, with minimal oversight

Fluent English, spoken and written



What we offer

Freelance role starting at ~20 hrs/week, with potential to grow into full-time

Fully remote, reliable availability within an agreed time window across time zones

No direct client contact — full focus on execution, testing, and scaling



To apply: Please send your CV/portfolio with concrete budget figures from accounts you've managed, and briefly answer:



Describe an account you scaled from a lower to a significantly higher monthly budget. How did it unfold, and what did you specifically change when performance started to tip?

Which platforms have you independently managed native ads on — Taboola, Outbrain, or both — and for how long? Give approximate budget sizes per account.

Tell us about a case where a campaign stagnated or crashed. How did you figure out whether the issue was the angle, creative, placement, or tracking?

title: Creative Strategist Native Ads

EVOLVE Digital is a performance marketing and e-commerce agency based in Germany, working with a fully remote, international team. Native Ads is a dedicated growth channel for us — not a leftover-budget channel. The bottleneck isn't the account, it's creative supply. That's exactly what you'll solve.



What you'll do

Develop angles based on audience research, buying motives, psychological triggers, and competitor analysis on Taboola and Outbrain

Concept AND produce image creatives yourself — in variants and at high speed (this is not a briefing-only role)

Use AI image tools deliberately to generate motifs, variants, and crops fast

Plan creative tests along clear variables (image motif, crop, headline, hook) and evaluate them together with media buying

Think through the full path from the ad through advertorial and pre-lander to the offer page

A portfolio of image creatives you conceived AND built yourself for paid e-commerce campaigns — concept and execution in one person, not a pure briefing role

Active, concrete use of AI tools in your own image production

E-commerce/D2C background, not purely B2B or lead-gen

Structured, self-directed way of working remotely and part-time, without outside oversight

Start part-time at ~20 hrs/week, with the potential to grow into full-time

Fully remote

A dedicated Creative Team with a direct interface to Native media buying, copywriting, and design

Those who help build the channel take on more accounts, more budget responsibility, and technical oversight of creative suppliers over time

title: Senior Amazon Listing & A+ Content Designer — Premium Product Visuals
description:
# Senior Amazon Listing & A+ Content Designer — Premium Product Visuals



We’re an established home-care product brand looking for an experienced designer to create a complete new Amazon listing image set and coordinated Premium A+ Content.



Our benchmark is the visual quality and attention to detail associated with **Dyson and Apple**: refined art direction, realistic product imagery, clean typography and consistent execution—while maintaining our own brand identity.



**Please apply only if your portfolio demonstrates this level of quality. If you cannot confidently deliver exceptionally polished, professional work, please do not apply.** We are looking for a meticulously finished listing, with every detail carefully considered.



Product details, the current listing and our creative brief will be shared privately with shortlisted candidates.



## Project Goals



The new visuals should:



* Establish a distinctive premium identity and communicate brand authenticity, quality and trust.

* Explain the product’s benefits through compelling visual storytelling.

* Clearly communicate correct use, compatibility, maintenance and package contents.

* Set accurate expectations to help reduce confusion, returns and negative reviews.

* Maintain a cohesive look across the gallery, A+ Content and product variants.



## Anticipated Scope



* Approximately 8–9 Amazon listing images, including the main image.

* A coordinated set of Premium A+ Content modules.

* Dedicated desktop and mobile layouts where applicable.

* Adaptations for two product color variants.

* High-resolution exports and organized, editable source files.



We have brand materials, product references and a visual audit to share. The final scope will be agreed after reviewing these materials and your recommendations.



## Creative Direction and Required Skills



We’re looking for clean compositions, realistic materials, controlled lighting, natural shadows, sophisticated typography and convincing lifestyle scenes.



The work should combine the appropriate techniques for each image:



* Advanced Photoshop retouching and compositing.

* Accurate 3D rendering or professional integration of supplied renders.

* AI-assisted imagery combined with detailed manual editing.

* Consistent color grading and realistic visual effects.

* Clear, mobile-friendly infographics and A+ layouts.



**AI tools are welcome, but generated images must be professionally refined and checked.** Product proportions, logos, controls and materials must remain accurate. Hands, reflections, perspective and lighting must look natural, with no visible artifacts or inconsistencies.



You should understand Amazon’s image and content requirements and be comfortable working with approved, substantiated product claims.



We also value strong creative judgment. We want your input on concepts, layouts and storytelling, alongside excellent execution.



## How to Apply



Please include:



1. **3–5 of your strongest relevant projects**—premium product campaigns, complete Amazon image sets or A+ Content.

2. Live listing links or detailed case studies, where available.

3. Your exact contribution to each example: art direction, retouching, compositing, AI generation, 3D or layout.

4. A brief explanation of your workflow and quality-control process.

5. Your availability and typical turnaround for a comparable project.

Reporting directly to the Managing Director, Product, this role sits at the intersection of brand storytelling, digital marketing, and product presentation. You’ll manage a Graphic Designer and serve as the creative authority on all product content — from the imagery that drives online conversion to the sell sheets and packaging that move product through wholesale partners.

This is a role best suited for someone who thinks strategically, executes precisely, and cares deeply about the mission behind the work.

Creative Leadership & Strategy

, DTC site, and any emerging placements. Brand standards don’t drift on this person’s watch.

•    Owns creative direction across all digital channels: paid social (Meta, TikTok), Amazon,
, DTC site, and any emerging placements.

Wholesale Content

•     Ensure product photography and specifications meet the requirements of key wholesale partners and retail buyers.

Team Management

•     Partner directly with paid media to close the feedback loop.

•    Direct internal creators and any external agency or freelance talent. Clear briefing, sharp feedback, no ambiguity about what good looks like.

•    Manages multiple concurrent production cycles without dropping handoffs. Product launches, seasonal campaigns, evergreen content, and paid creative tests all run in parallel.

•    Interface with paid media, organic social,
, and wholesale channels as needed. Cross-functional by default, not by exception.



Qualifications:

Required

•     Demonstrated experience creating product content for eCommerce platforms (DTC and/or marketplace).

•     Strong portfolio showcasing product photography direction, digital design, and brand-consistent visual storytelling.

•     Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) and familiarity with Figma or similar tools.

•     Experience briefing and directing photographers, videographers, or other creative vendors.

•     Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.

•     Knows the difference between a scroll-stopping hook frame and a pretty image that converts nobody.

Preferred

•      Passion for ocean conservation or environmental causes.

Every month, you will carefully analyse customer feedback and quality issues to identify opportunities for improvement. You will work directly with suppliers through regular problem-solving conversations via Zoom and WeChat, as well as analyse new product samples and improvements together with the CEO.



You will also lead projects for our products to be safety tested and submitted into relevant award competitions.

Call customers regarding outstanding balances

Cash collected.



We care about results, not meaningless activity.

Collection rate

Promise-to-pay conversion

Promise-kept rate

Payment plans activated

Recovery of missed payment plans

Number of unresolved accounts progressing to the correct next stage

Credit-card companies

Financial-services companies

Accounts receivable departments

Collections agencies

Consumer or commercial credit teams

Persistent

Highly organised

Calm under pressure

Confident on the phone

Good at negotiation

Excellent at following a process

Comfortable working independently

title: Senior Customer Support Specialist – AI-Driven (Shopify E-commerce)
description:
Own the customer experience, don't just answer tickets. We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand hiring someone to run point on resolution quality and the AI workflow behind it.



You are not here to clear a queue and clock out. You are here to own the outcome of every ticket, catch what the process and the AI miss, and treat the customer experience like it's yours. This is an individual contributor role, not a task-only one. Do it well and a bigger one opens up.



We're not a traditional support team stacking human review on top of every ticket. Our AI agent resolves most tickets on its own, and this role exists to make it smarter, not to double-check it.



What You'll Own



* The outcome of every ticket you touch. Not just closing it, actually solving it.

* The harder cases the AI escalates to you: disputes, refunds, anything needing judgment.

* Making the AI better. Improve its guidance from real tickets so the same issue doesn't come back twice.

* The patterns. Spot recurring friction early and bring the fix, not just the complaint.



Must-Haves (be ready to show evidence, not just claim these)



* 2+ years in e-commerce customer support, with a specific example of something you improved that no one asked you to.

* Real Shopify depth. You can diagnose an order or payment problem from the admin, not just read a customer their tracking number.

* A helpdesk you've worked in daily (we use Commslayer). Quick on new tools.

* Hands-on experience with an AI system that takes action on tickets, not a writing assistant like ChatGPT. You trust a well-trained AI's output over manually re-verifying it against the source system, and when it's wrong, you know how to fix its guidance instead of working around it.

* Comfortable without SOPs or step-by-step checklists. We operate on principles, not scripts. If you need a checklist to feel confident doing the job, this isn't the role.

* Problem solving to root cause. You reason through an unfamiliar system to figure out how it behaves instead of escalating.

* Strong written English. Clear, warm, precise.

* Full-time, exclusive, long-term. Tuesday to Saturday, 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM (Next day) Manila time (8-hour shift plus a 1-hour break). Rest days Sunday to Monday.



Not for You If



* You see this as "just a job."

* You need step-by-step direction and go quiet when something's off.

* You hand over problems instead of solving them.

* You measure yourself by ticket count instead of whether the customer's actual problem got solved.

* You believe every order or tracking detail needs a human double-check before it reaches a customer, no matter what the AI already verified.



How We Hire

This application takes real thought, and that's on purpose. Low-effort or AI-generated answers won't advance, and we respect your time enough to tell you that up front.



1. Answer our application questions properly.

2. We respond to every applicant. No ghosting.

3. Qualified applicants complete a short first interview on experience and fit.

4. Those who pass complete a short technical interview.

5. Crush it, and we send you an offer.



Full-Time Perks (after a 1 to 2 month probation)



* 13th-month pay

* 18+ days of paid time off

* Every AI tool you need, paid for by us

* Health insurance (HMO)

* An annual training and learning budget

* The option to fly out and meet the rest of the team



We genuinely take care of our team and invest heavily in our people. We want someone who takes ownership, grows with us, and builds something meaningful for the long term.



Apply now. It takes 5 minutes :

title: Legal Executive Assistant
description:
Legal Executive Assistant LA0926A

Remote — Philippines | Australian Corporate Commercial Law Firm

Remote (Philippines) | Full-time | Monday–Friday, 7:00am–3:00pm PH time (9:00am–5:00pm AEST, Sydney)

Apply here: 



About the Role

A boutique Australian corporate commercial law firm — offices in Melbourne, Sydney and Dubai — is looking for an experienced Executive Assistant to work directly with the Director and Principal Solicitor.

This is not a junior support role, and it is not a task-taking role. The Director is currently the last line of defence on everything that leaves the firm: every invoice, every client
, every document. She checks all of it because there is no system in place that reliably catches problems before she does.

You are being hired to build that system.

Two things sit at the centre of this role. The first is taking the day-to-day operational load off the Director entirely — the diary, the billing, the matters, the correspondence — so she can practise law and grow the firm. The second is turning how the firm works into something documented, visible and easy to follow, so the onsite junior admin team produces clean, accurate work without the Director having to inspect it.

If you cannot help but build a checklist, a template or a tracker whenever you see something being done inconsistently, this role is built for you.



What You'll Do

Executive support and diary management

Own the Director's calendar: court dates, client meetings, travel, networking commitments

Protect her time — triage what reaches her and what does not

Coordinate across three offices, multiple time zones and frequent international travel

Anticipate what she needs before she asks

Billing, time entries and invoicing

Reconstruct and enter the Director's billable time from calls,
s and meetings, with narratives written so the client understands exactly what they are paying for

Run the monthly invoicing cycle end to end: review costs agreements, check trust balances and payments received, draft invoices for review

Build this into a regular, predictable rhythm rather than a month-end scramble

Follow up professionally on outstanding accounts

Matter management

Open and prepare new matters from intake through to the point legal work can begin

Draft costs agreements and manage costs disclosure

Run ASIC, company and related searches via InfoTrack

Complete client identity and verification checks

Court and deadline management

Monitor court registries daily for listing changes, orders and judgments

Own the deadline architecture of the practice so nothing is ever missed

Correspondence

Draft client and third-party correspondence — accurate, articulate, in Australian legal register

Handle client contact with the polish that clients paying premium fees expect

Systems, documentation and quality — the heart of this role

Take the firm's existing admin manual and turn it into a working system: clear, current, structured, and genuinely usable by someone doing the task for the first time

Document processes as you learn them, so knowledge sits in the system rather than in someone's head

Build the templates, checklists, naming conventions and review steps that make correct output the default and errors hard to make

Make work visible — who is doing what, what stage it is at, what is outstanding — so the Director does not have to ask

Set the quality standard for outgoing work and review against it. Typos, formatting, tone and accuracy in client-facing documents are the firm's reputation

Support the onsite junior admin team by giving them systems clear enough to follow, and coach them on the standard

Identify what is being done inefficiently and propose a better way — having already thought it through



What You'll Bring

Experience and tools

Direct experience working for an Australian law firm as an Executive Assistant, paralegal, legal assistant or legal secretary

Hands-on, day-to-day experience with LEAP — time entries, matter management, billing runs, trust and office accounting

Working knowledge of InfoTrack (or GlobalX / Dye & Durham) for ASIC and company searches

Microsoft Outlook and Teams

A track record of creating process documentation, templates or systems that other people then used. Be ready to describe something you built and what changed because of it

Exceptional written English in Australian legal register. Spelling, punctuation and formatting are not negotiable

Experience in a genuinely high-pressure, deadline-driven environment

How you work

You build systems instinctively. Doing the task once is fine; you would rather set it up so it is done correctly every time after that

You are the quality gate. Nothing leaves on your watch with an error on it, and you notice the misplaced full stop

Solutions, not problems. You come to the Director with "here is what happened and here is how I have already fixed it"

Calm under pressure. When something goes wrong, the room steadies because you are in it

Self-directed. You check the
 chain before you ask the question

You influence without authority. People follow your process because it is clear and you have made the case for it

Ambitious. You want to build something, and to grow with a firm that is expanding fast



Bonus Points For

Corporate commercial, litigation or transactional practice background

Costs agreements, costs disclosure and trust accounting under Australian rules

Experience working remotely alongside an onsite team

Experience improving or rebuilding a firm's practice management setup



Work Setup

Hours: Monday to Friday, 7:00am–3:00pm Philippine time (9:00am–5:00pm AEST, Sydney)

Scheduled hours only. This is a defined full-time schedule. You are not expected to be available outside it, and EAI holds that boundary on your behalf

Fully remote from the Philippines. You will need a reliable internet connection and a quiet, professional work environment

One client, one associate. You work with this firm exclusively — no juggling accounts. This role is not compatible with concurrent employment or freelance work

You are employed and supported by EAI, with health insurance, statutory benefits and paid leave



Why This Role

Direct partnership with a Director building an international firm, with real influence over how the practice runs

Genuine scope to design the operating systems of a growing legal practice, not just execute someone else's

Career progression as the firm grows — this role sits at the top of the practice support function

Opportunity for international travel with the Director, and potential longer-term relocation and visa pathways for the right person

Dedicated coaching, a professional community, and ongoing training and development through EAI throughout your placement



Next Step

Submit your application here: 

Applications are reviewed as they arrive. Shortlisted candidates complete a written assessment and screening interview before being presented to the client.

title: Unity Developer - (Mobile Gaming) Full-Time | Remote | Local Hours | Monthly Contract | Paid Holiday
description:
We make mobile games and we're looking for a Unity developer to join our creative production team. Your job isn't building games from scratch — it's taking scenes from our existing title that have already proven themselves in ad creatives, and producing a high volume of polished iterations: new layouts, fresh angles, visual tweaks, and gameplay variations that we can test as new ad content. You'll be working inside a mature project with a large library of existing mechanics, systems, and assets to draw on, so most of the raw material is already there — your job is to recombine it, push it, and make it shine.

It's repetitive work by nature, but the best person for this role will bring genuine creative instinct to every iteration — spotting what makes a scene compelling and finding new ways to push it further. You'll have access to our analytics platform, so you can see exactly how each ad performs and iterate intelligently on what's working rather than guessing. If you can go beyond the brief and conceive your own original concepts that hook a viewer in the first two seconds and keep them watching, there's real room to grow with us — and real money in it: we pay bonuses when an iteration or concept you've made becomes a creative winner.



CLI AI programming tools are a must for speed and efficiency.



What You'll Be Doing

- Taking high-performing Unity scenes and producing multiple creative iterations — new camera angles, layouts,

  lighting, and  visual treatments

- Building new variations from our existing library of mechanics, prefabs, and assets rather than creating everything 

  from scratch

- Reviewing ad performance data in our analytics platform and using it to d
 what to iterate on next

- Recording and uploading large volumes of raw gameplay footage for use across our creative pipeline

- Building and applying interesting shaders to add visual polish and variety

- Introducing new mechanics or design ideas within existing scene frameworks

- Pitching and executing your own original scene concepts — exhilarating, captivating footage that retains viewers and 

  performs as ad content

- Working within an established codebase — reading, extending, and modifying existing scripts confidently

- Using CLI programming tools to accelerate development and handle boilerplate work



What We're Looking For

- Solid Unity experience with a strong portfolio that shows 3D work — this is a must and the most important thing. We need 

   to see 3D scenes, environments, cameras, lighting, or effects you've built in Unity

- Comfortable working inside an existing project and codebase rather than building from zero

- Experience writing custom shaders (Shader Graph or HLSL)

- A creative eye — you should be able to look at a scene and have ideas, not just wait to be told what to change

- Comfortable reading performance data and letting it guide your creative decisions

- Self-directed and productive working remotely with minimal hand-holding

- Comfortable with repetitive, output-focused work without letting quality slip

  

Nice to Have

- Video editing skills — even basic ability to capture and cut together scene recordings is a bonus

- Familiarity with mobile game ad creative trends (what hooks work, what visual styles perform)

- Experience with CLI programming tools in your development workflow

  

Salary, Bonuses & Growth

- Starting salary is based on experience and portfolio

- Performance bonuses are paid whenever a creative you've produced becomes a winner — the more your iterations 

   and concepts perform, the more you earn

- We review performance after an initial period, and those who demonstrate strong output and creative initiative can 

   expect salary progression — this is a role where the right person can grow quickly



To Apply

- Share your portfolio — 3D Unity projects, shaders, or anything that shows your work in action. Video or GIF demos of 

   scenes or effects are ideal. Applications without 3D Unity work in the portfolio won't be considered

title: Sales Account Executive / Closer
description:
Sales Account Executive / Closer – StackWise Technology LLC



Location: Remote (work from anywhere)  

Type: Full-Time | Independent Contractor (1099)  

Compensation: Base pay plus commission (details provided in interview)



About Us



StackWise Technology LLC is a growing telecom renewal brokerage. We help businesses renew and optimize their existing telecom service agreements.



Our model is relationship-driven. We work primarily with existing business customers and qualified renewal opportunities rather than relying on traditional cold outbound sales.



We provide the leads, appointment-setting support, CRM, tools, training, and back-office assistance. Our Account Executives focus on what they do best: speaking with customers, identifying the right solution, and closing business.



The Role



We’re looking for a motivated Sales Account Executive / Closer to join our remote sales team.



You will receive qualified appointments generated by our Sales Development Representatives. Your responsibility is to conduct the sales conversation, understand the customer’s current services and needs, present the appropriate renewal solution, handle objections, follow up, and move qualified opportunities through to signature.



This is a closing role, not a high-volume cold-calling position.



The ideal candidate is confident on the phone, comfortable speaking with business owners and decision-makers, organized with follow-up, and capable of guiding a customer toward a decision without using high-pressure sales tactics.



What You’ll Do



- Take qualified appointments booked by our SDR team.

- Speak with existing business customers regarding telecom contract renewals and service options.

- Conduct discovery to understand the customer’s current services, needs, concerns, and renewal situation.

- Present appropriate telecom renewal solutions in a clear and professional manner.

- Handle objections and answer customer questions.

- Follow up consistently with open opportunities.

- Move qualified opportunities from appointment through proposal, contract, and signature.

- Maintain accurate notes, next steps, and opportunity stages in our CRM.

- Coordinate with our SDR and back-office teams to keep deals moving.

- Maintain weekly and monthly sales targets.

- Represent StackWise professionally and maintain a customer-first sales approach.



What We Provide



- Qualified appointments from dedicated SDRs.

- Warm renewal opportunities with existing business customers.

- Base pay plus commission.

- Company-provided CRM, dialer,
, messenger, and sales tools.

- Sales scripts, processes, objection-handling guidance, and training.

- Back-office support for contracts, pricing, and order processing.

- Coaching and performance feedback.

- A clear opportunity to grow as StackWise expands its sales organization.

- A sales environment where the closer can spend the majority of their time actually selling rather than prospecting.



What We’re Looking For



- Previous closing experience strongly preferred.

- B2B sales experience preferred.

- Telecom, technology, SaaS, insurance, financial services, or other consultative sales experience is a plus.

- Excellent spoken English with a clear, professional phone presence.

- Comfortable speaking with business owners, managers, and decision-makers.

- Strong discovery and objection-handling ability.

- Able to confidently ask for the sale and move customers toward a decision.

- Strong follow-up discipline.

- Organized and comfortable managing multiple opportunities in a CRM.

- Self-motivated, dependable, competitive, and coachable.

- Comfortable working toward measurable revenue and closing targets.

- Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet professional workspace.

- Able to work full-time during U.S. business hours.

- Comfortable working as an independent contractor (1099).



What Success Looks Like



A successful Account Executive at StackWise:



- Shows up prepared for every scheduled appointment.

- Builds trust quickly with customers.

- Asks questions before presenting a solution.

- Keeps opportunities moving instead of allowing deals to sit without follow-up.

- Maintains clean CRM notes and clear next steps.

- Handles objections calmly and professionally.

- Consistently converts qualified appointments into signed agreements.

- Takes ownership of their pipeline and monthly MRC production.



Who This Role Is Best For



This position is a strong fit for someone who enjoys closing more than prospecting.



Our SDR team is responsible for creating opportunities. Your job is to take those opportunities and turn them into revenue.



If you are comfortable conducting business-to-business sales conversations, managing a pipeline, following up persistently, and asking customers for the business, we want to hear from you.

title: Full-Time Short-Form Video Editor — $1,000+/mo — Established TikTok/UGC Page (Long-Term Role)
description:
READ THIS FIRST



This application requires a paid test video. It takes about an hour and I pay $25 USD for it whether or not I hire you.



Applications without a test video are deleted unread. Not set aside, not reviewed later - deleted. I've run this post before without the test as a hard requirement and got thirty applications I couldn't tell apart. I'd rather read five real edits than fifty resumes.



If that's not something you want to do, no hard feelings, but please don't apply - you'll be spending your time for nothing.



INTERVIEWS HAVE ALREADY STARTED. There is no closing date because there doesn't need to be one. I'm reviewing tests as they arrive and interviewing the strong ones the same week. The moment I find the right editor this post comes down. If you're reading this and you want the role, do the test today. Every day you wait is a day the seat is more likely already filled.



THE TEST



Folder (everything you need for the test is in here):





Inside, you'll find the reference video, the raw footage, and a "Further Directions" file. Read that file before you start.



POSITION



Full-Time Short-Form Video Editor — $1,000+/mo — Established TikTok/UGC Page (Long-Term Role)



TYPE / SALARY



Full Time · 5–6 days per week · PH or similar time zone $1,000 USD/month starting, potential for performance bonuses. Raises tied to skill and results.



JOB DESCRIPTION



I run a TikTok page and produce UGC that consistently reaches large audiences. I'm looking for one editor to take ownership of the editing work alongside me, long term.



Success in this role comes down to two things above all else: editing quality and English comprehension. Because of that, this posting is specific about what the work requires, and the application asks for more than a résumé. I'd rather be clear upfront than have either of us discover a mismatch a month in.



THE WORK



Daily short-form vertical content — mostly talking heads with occasional voiceover/b-roll:



Cutting dead space so videos stay paced and never drag

Stitching the strongest takes into one seamless piece

Adding image overlays on screen to support what's being said

Zooms, crops, and reframes to keep the frame dynamic

B-roll builds: I provide a voiceover and footage, you find the visual that matches each line

Sourcing your own overlay assets — reading the script and independently finding the images it calls for



The last two items are the core of the role. The rest is technical work most editors can learn. Choosing the right visual for the right sentence is what separates a video that reaches 4,000 people from one that reaches 4,000,000.



SOURCING YOUR OWN ASSETS



This is one of the most important parts of the job, and the part most editors are not set up for. I'll give you background and direction, but I want you fully self-sufficient at finding the visuals a script needs. That means:



Reading the script and working out which images the moment actually calls for

Finding high-quality, aesthetically strong photos of who/what is being discussed — not the first search result, but the image that looks right on screen

Learning the brands I work with well enough to represent them correctly

Knowing which parts of a brand's website are worth capturing, and pulling clean screenshots of them

Sourcing relevant comments, posts, and screenshots that support the point being made

Placing every asset at the right moment in the video, on the beat the script lands on



I shouldn't have to send you an image folder for a video to get made. You should be able to take the script and go find what it needs.



This requires genuinely understanding English — hearing a sentence and catching the humor, the tone, the reference — because you can't source the right image for a line you don't fully understand. Your English does not need to be perfect. It needs to be strong enough that you follow everything being said and that we can communicate quickly and clearly. Familiarity with internet and pop culture is a significant advantage here, and it's rewarded.



EXAMPLES OF THE WORK



Please watch all three before applying so you know exactly what you'd be producing.



Basic talking head — cutting dead space, piecing clips together, light crops and zooms: 

Talking head with overlays — the same, plus supplied images placed on screen: 

B-roll — a voiceover with footage matched to it line by line. This is where English comprehension shows most: 



WHO I'M LOOKING FOR

Strong attention to detail. You catch the frame held a beat too long or the overlay that sits slightly off. This is the most important quality in the role.

Self-sufficiency with assets. You can take a script and go find the images it needs without being handed a folder. This is weighted as heavily as your editing.

Willingness to go the extra step. Reviewing your own export once more and fixing what wasn't flagged.

Strong English comprehension. Understanding is essential; polished speaking and writing is a bonus.

Responsive communication. When I message during working hours, I need a reply promptly rather than the following day.

Exclusivity. This is a full-time position and I'm looking for someone working with me only — no other clients, agencies, or subcontracting. In return you get stability, a real salary, and an employer invested in your growth.

A long-term outlook. I'm hiring someone to grow with my content over years, not to fill a short-term gap.



This role likely isn't the right fit if you're applying broadly today, prefer briefs explained in detail more than once, or intend to use AI to write your application answers — I'm looking for your own thinking.



REQUIREMENTS

Proven experience editing short-form vertical video (TikTok / Reels / Shorts)

CapCut or any software you work quickly in — the output is what matters

Confident sourcing your own images, screenshots, and reference material online, with good taste in what looks right on screen

Reliable internet and a computer that handles daily editing without issues

Available full time, with reasonable overlap with my hours. The volume moves with the content schedule — some weeks run 4–5 days, others run 6–7. I need someone who can flex with it rather than hold to a fixed number of days

Able to receive payment via Wise

Comfortable receiving direct feedback and applying it the first time



PAY AND GROWTH



$1,000 USD/month paid through Wise, with potential for performance bonuses. The ceiling on this role sits well above the starting salary — as you learn my style and begin contributing your own ideas, your compensation grows accordingly. You'd be working directly with me each day on videos that have proven to get millions of views.



HOW TO APPLY



Subject line: EDITOR — [number of the example video above you think is hardest to edit] (For example: EDITOR — 2. Applications that don't follow this format won't be reviewed.)



Please include in your message:



Links to 2–3 short-form videos you personally edited, and what you handled on each. If you worked on only part of a video, please say so — accuracy matters more to me than scope.

In your own words, 3–5 sentences, without AI assistance: watch example #3 and describe one editing choice that worked well and one you would have approached differently. There's no right answer — I'm interested in how you evaluate a video.

The software you use and how long you've worked in it.

Your internet speed (a speed test screenshot is ideal) and your typical available hours in PH time.

One sentence on your current work and why you're looking to move.



Paid test — $25 USD. Applicants completing the paid test will use the Google Drive folder linked below, which contains the reference video, original voiceover take, raw footage, and further directions. You'll stitch together the strongest takes, match footage to the voiceover, and send back your version. Note that the folder deliberately does not contain every image the script calls for — part of the test is sourcing a few visuals yourself and placing them where you feel they could belong. It should take about an hour. This test is paid $25 USD regardless of the hiring outcome — I don't ask anyone to work unpaid.



Google Drive (reference video and source files): 



A strong test is followed by a short call, and then a start date. I review every application that follows the instructions above.

Customer Care & Sales Agent (Inbound Support + Design Follow-Up) — Wellness Brand, Full-Time, Remote



Job Type: Full-Time

Salary: $8 to $10/hour (USD), depending on experience, plus a KPI-based bonus

Schedule: Full-time, night shift (approx. 9:00 PM to 5:00 AM PHT) to cover our UK and US clients



About the Company



PilatesGoods is a fast-growing international B2B brand. We supply custom branded grip socks and studio essentials to Pilates, yoga, and barre studios across six markets worldwide. We are a start-up, not a "slow corporate" company. We move fast, we care about how things look, and we treat our clients like partners, not just accounts.



If a start-up pace and environment sound exciting to you, keep reading. If that's not your style, this isn't the right role, and it's better we both know that now.



This is a 50-50 role



This job is split roughly evenly between two things: customer care and sales. About half your time you'll be looking after existing clients (answering questions, handling complaints, keeping people happy), and the other half you'll help new studio owners go from a design request to a paid order. We're looking for someone who is genuinely good at both, not someone who only wants to sell or only wants to do support.



About the hours



This is a night shift. Your hours (roughly 9:00 PM to 5:00 AM Philippine time) are built to overlap with our clients in the UK and the US. Please only apply if you are genuinely comfortable working nights on a long-term basis. During your onboarding period there will also be some overlap with our Dutch team at the start of your shift, so your questions get answered fast while you learn the business.



What You'll Be Doing



Customer Care (about half your time)



Handle inbound questions and complaints from studio owners and their teams, across
, phone, and Instagram.

De-escalate tense situations calmly and professionally. Your main job here is to stop small frustrations from turning into big problems.

Take ownership of an issue from start to finish: understand it, communicate clearly, and follow through until the client is genuinely satisfied.

Turn a frustrated customer into a loyal one. How we handle problems is a big part of our reputation.

Loop in the right internal people (operations, design) when a problem needs it, and keep the client updated in the meantime.



Sales (about half your time)



Handle inbound leads from studio owners who requested a custom design for their products.

Send product designs to clients and follow up until they make a decision.

Guide clients from first message to paid invoice, aiming to close details within a handful of
s.

Spot genuine upsell opportunities (like embroidery or upgraded materials) when they add real value for the client, not just extra cost.

Read between the lines: understand what a client needs even when they don't say it directly.



Across both



Monitor and reply to Instagram DMs and comments through Manychat, matching your tone to the situation (professional, friendly, or casual with emojis when it fits).

Use AI tools daily for translation, drafting, and research. We work with clients worldwide, so this is a core part of the job, not an occasional task.



Requirements



Comfortable working a night shift (roughly 9:00 PM to 5:00 AM PHT) on a long-term basis.

Flawless spoken and written English. This role includes phone calls with clients, and because we sell mainly into the UK and US markets, a clear and natural American accent is a must.

Completed a higher education degree.

Proven customer care or customer support experience, especially handling complaints and de-escalating unhappy clients. This is essential, not a nice-to-have.

Sales experience (inbound sales, follow-up, closing).

Familiarity with the wellness, fitness, or studio scene (pilates, yoga, barre, or similar) is a strong plus.

Previous experience working with Dutch or European companies is a strong plus.

Able to work independently and take ownership after training. This is not a role with constant supervision.

Starting at $8 to $10 per hour (USD), depending on experience, plus a KPI-based bonus structure once you're fully onboarded.

description:
# Social Media, Content & Community Growth Specialist



### About Us



We are a fast-growing digital health company building high-quality, user-friendly online experiences for our customers. We’re looking for a creative and resourceful Social Media, Content & Community Growth Specialist to help us create great content, grow our organic audiences, and support our broader marketing team.



This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys creating content but also understands how to **build an audience and community — not simply post to a social media calendar.**



### What You'll Do



* Manage and grow our organic presence across **TikTok, Instagram,
, YouTube, YouTube Shorts, Reddit, Threads, Pinterest, and other relevant platforms**.

* Develop social content designed to increase **reach, engagement, followers, subscribers, and brand awareness**.

* Look for trends, content formats, topics, and creative opportunities that can help us reach new audiences.

* Create and repurpose content for **TikTok, Reels, YouTube Shorts, videos, graphics, carousels, social posts, and other platform-specific formats**.

* Help develop short-form video concepts, hooks, scripts, and creative ideas.

* Build, manage, and grow our **owned Reddit communities/subreddits** by creating useful content, starting conversations, engaging members, and encouraging ongoing community participation.

* Develop content and discussion ideas that give people a reason to join our communities and keep coming back.

* Work with our outreach and marketing team to turn insights from external communities into new social, Reddit, and content opportunities.

* Write, edit, format, and publish **blog articles and website content**.

* Create attractive graphics and marketing assets using **Canva, Figma, Adobe tools, or similar platforms**.

* Produce creative assets for the broader marketing team, including social media, paid advertising, blog graphics, landing pages,
, and other marketing campaigns.

* Maintain content calendars and keep social, blog, and creative production organized and consistently moving.

* Review content and social performance to understand what is working and use those learnings to improve future content.



### What We're Looking For



* Experience managing social media accounts and **growing organic audiences — not just scheduling and publishing posts**.

* Strong understanding of platforms such as TikTok, Instagram,
, YouTube, YouTube Shorts, and Reddit.

* Understanding of what drives **reach, engagement, watch time, shares, comments, followers, subscribers, and community growth**.

* Experience creating or helping produce short-form video content.

* Strong writing and communication skills.

* Comfortable writing and publishing blog content.

* Good visual instincts and experience creating graphics and marketing assets.

* Experience with Canva, Figma, Adobe Express, or similar creative tools.

* Creative and curious — someone who naturally looks for new content ideas, trends, and opportunities.

* Comfortable testing new approaches, reviewing performance, and improving based on what works.

* Organized, dependable, and able to manage several types of content at the same time.



### What Success Looks Like



You won't be measured simply by how many posts you publish. We want someone who can help us:



* Grow engaged audiences across our social channels.

* Build active communities people want to participate in.

* Consistently produce useful, engaging content.

* Increase organic reach, engagement, followers, subscribers, and traffic.

* Identify successful content ideas and turn them into more opportunities.

* Provide the broader marketing team with a steady flow of strong creative assets.



### How You'll Work With the Team



You’ll work closely with our other marketing specialists.



Our **Authority & Outreach team** will focus on external communities, outreach, partnerships, reputation, and participating in relevant conversations across Reddit and other platforms.



Your focus will be on **our organic social channels, our owned communities, and the content and creative assets needed to grow them**.

title: Email Support Expert — Shopify DTC brand
description:
We're looking for a customer service specialist who understands one thing clearly:

A good reply doesn't just sound polite. It answers the real question, solves the problem before it grows, and turns a frustrated customer into one who orders again.

We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand selling K-beauty skincare products to women over 40. We currently sell in Italy, Spain, UK and we're actively expanding across Europe, with new markets launching soon. Paid social is one of our main growth channels — which means most customers meet us through an ad, arrive with questions, and write to us in their own language. Support is not a cost center for us, it's one of the biggest drivers of trust, retention, and repeat revenue.

We're looking for someone who can own that inbox across several languages — and who can do it using a modern, AI-driven workflow that lets us answer fast, absorb volume, and open new markets without the quality dropping.

This role is ideal for someone who understands e-commerce support, multilingual communication, courier problems, refunds and disputes, AI-assisted workflows, and the difference between closing a ticket and keeping a customer.



--- WHAT YOU'LL BE HANDLING ---

You'll be working the inbox of a DTC brand running paid traffic, which means:

— "Where is my order": stalled tracking, parcels stuck at a hub, deliveries marked complete but never received

— Pre-purchase questions: people who saw the ad and want to know if it works and if we're real

— Product and skin questions: ingredients, how to use it, what to expect and when, sensitive skin, pregnancy

— Reactions and complaints: rare, serious, handled carefully and escalated properly

— Refunds, returns and withdrawal: EU consumer rules, our guarantee, and knowing when to say yes

— Disputes and chargebacks: PayPal and card cases, caught early enough to resolve instead of lose

— Comments and DMs under our ads: public, and often a cold audience's first impression of us

— Win-back conversations: the ones that turn a solved problem into another order



--- WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR ---

We're not looking for someone who writes beautiful, polite
s and nothing else.

Anyone can do that now. AI made good prose free, which means good prose is no longer the job.

We're looking for someone who works the ticket before writing it. You should:

— Read the real carrier events, not the tracking link the customer already saw

— Check whether this person wrote before, and what was promised last time

— Notice the payment method — PayPal and card have different dispute clocks

— Tell a policy abuser apart from someone genuinely upset and about to leave one star

— Chase the courier yourself instead of telling the customer to keep waiting

— D
 within your limits instead of escalating everything and slowing the queue

— Close the conversation, so the same person doesn't write three more times

You should be able to take a Shopify order, a tracking page that hasn't moved in five days and an angry customer, and turn it into a resolved ticket and a customer who stays.



--- LANGUAGES (NON-NEGOTIABLE) ---

Our customers write from all over Europe, and every
 is answered in the language it arrived in — never in English, and never in something that reads like it came out of a translator. A customer can tell within one sentence.

— English at a top level, written and spoken. It's our working language and the one you translate through

— You don't need to be native in every market. You do need replies a native reader wouldn't flag as translated

— Which means catching what translation tools get wrong: formality in German, politeness register in French, warmth in Italian and Spanish

— Any European language you genuinely have is a strong plus, not a requirement

— Written level is what counts. You'll be judged on the
s you write, not on a certificate

If your English isn't strong enough to move quickly and accurately in both directions, this role isn't the right fit.



--- HOW WE USE AI (AND HOW WE DON'T) ---

We assume you use AI. Everyone does, and we'd be concerned if you didn't. What matters is how. You should be confident in:

— Drafting and translating with it, and holding one consistent tone across every language

— Building your own prompts, macros and saved replies, so the same answer isn't rewritten fifty times

— Checking every fact first: AI invents shipping dates and policies, and the customer holds us to them

— Knowing which tickets it never touches alone: reactions, legal threats, disputes, anyone on their third

— Spotting the answer that is technically correct and still wrong, because it missed the problem underneath

— Keeping the result human: a reply that reads as generated costs more trust than a slower one would have

If your workflow is pasting the customer's
 into ChatGPT and sending back whatever comes out, this role isn't the right fit.



--- THE KIND OF PERSON WHO WILL THRIVE HERE ---

You'll be a strong fit if you:

— Have handled real volume for an e-commerce brand, and know your daily ticket count

— Know your own numbers: response time, refund rate, chargeback rate, contact rate

— Are comfortable inside Shopify: orders, fulfillments, refunds, customer history

— Know what macros, tags and SLAs are actually for

— Chase people internally when something is stuck, without being asked twice

— Write short: six clear lines beat three paragraphs, in every language

— Stay calm with someone being unfair to you, and calm again the third time

— Have judgment about money: a partial refund today often beats a chargeback next week

— Notice patterns: thirty
s about one thing means something upstream is broken

— Care whether the customer comes back, not just whether the ticket is closed

We care about support that protects revenue. That doesn't mean saying no to customers. It means every reply — and every refund decision — should support the relationship, the trust, and the next order.



--- SKILLS & EXPERIENCE ---

Ideally, you have experience with:

— Customer service for an e-commerce or DTC brand running paid social

— Shopify: orders, refunds, fulfillments, customer history

— A helpdesk: Gorgias, Zendesk, Freshdesk, Front, Intercom, or similar

—
, WhatsApp, live chat, and Instagram and
 
 and comments

— Carrier tracking and claims, and dealing with couriers on missing parcels

— Refunds, returns and EU consumer rules, including the right of withdrawal

— PayPal and card disputes, resolved before they become chargebacks

— ChatGPT, Claude, DeepL, or an AI agent inside the helpdesk

Bonus if you've worked with beauty, skincare, or K-beauty brands targeting a female audience over 40.



--- WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING DAY TO DAY ---

— Answering
s in the language they arrived in, inside our response time targets

— Working each ticket properly: order, tracking, history and payment checked before you reply

— Chasing couriers on stuck parcels, and d
 when to reship

— Handling refunds, returns and withdrawal requests within your limits

— Catching disputes early, before they become chargebacks

— Replying to comments and DMs under our ads, where a cold audience is watching

— Improving macros, saved replies and prompts so the whole queue gets faster

— Flagging patterns: the product page that causes tickets, the courier that keeps failing

— Adapting tone and templates as each new European market opens



--- WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU ---

— Competitive compensation based on experience

— Performance-based bonuses tied to real numbers: response time, satisfaction, refund rate

— Access to premium AI and support tools — fully covered by us

— Real autonomy: a spending limit you can d
 within, from early on

— Owning the customer relationship for a brand growing across multiple European markets

— Long-term growth with a fast-scaling D2C brand expanding internationally

We're building a serious e-commerce brand, and we're looking for someone who knows that support is where trust is either built or lost — using both real judgment about customers and money, and the AI tools that make modern support possible at scale.

If you're a multilingual customer service specialist who works the ticket AND lives in the AI workflow, we'd love to hear from you.



--- READY TO APPLY? ---

If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply here:

Agile Execution: Work closely with the Chief of Staff as processes and SOPs evolve, quickly turning new direction into consistent day-to-day execution across Arc Remote, Kipkeh, and SetCo.

Executive Unburdening: Take ownership of recurring client, team, and operational matters so the CEO can stay focused on higher-level priorities.



Skills & Qualifications



US BPO / Leadership Experience: 5+ years in BPO Client Success, Account Management, Team Lead, Operations, or similar roles working directly with US accounts.

Flawless American English (Strict): Exceptional written and spoken English with a natural, accent-neutral American pronunciation and the ability to project authority on US client calls.

High EQ & Leadership: Able to manage client expectations, hold team members accountable, give direct feedback, and handle difficult situations professionally.

High-Agency Execution: You do not wait for step-by-step instructions. You identify what needs to happen, take ownership, and keep things moving.



Compensation & Career Growth



Monthly Salary: $1,300 – $1,700 USD / month (Scaled strictly to capabilities and experience).

Reliable Payments: Secure, predictable weekly processing via Wise.

Long-Term Trajectory: This role is designed for growth. As our ecosystem scales, you will have a direct path to grow into a Senior/Director leadership role.



HOW TO APPLY (STRICT REQUIREMENTS)

We filter ruthlessly for attention to detail. If you do not follow these steps perfectly, your application will be automatically deleted.

In your message, provide direct viewable links to below mandatory files (e.g., Google Drive, iCloud, strictly set to "Anyone with the link can view"):



Updated Resume / CV

System Specifications (Screenshot): Must show a minimum of 16GB RAM. (If under 16GB, you must explicitly state in your text response that your hardware is upgradable).

Client Communication Audio Sample: To evaluate your client-facing tone and American English proficiency, include a link (Vocaroo, Google Drive audio, etc.) of a 60-second mock voi
.

 to a US business owner named John. Let him know that his new remote assistant has been fully vetted, the software is set up, and they are ready to start on Monday. Ask him to call you back to confirm the final Zoom kickoff time."

title: Senior Website & CRO Strategist
description:
Ikigai Cases is hiring for a Senior Website & CRO Strategist

Location: Remote

Compensation: $42,000 per year + performance-based bonuses



About the Company

Ikigai Cases (
) is a fast-growing ecommerce brand manufacturing aerospace-grade aluminum pill cases. Founded in December 2021 by two brothers after their father’s neurological diagnosis led them to discovering the issues with plastic pill organizers, we’ve built a multi-million dollar business in just over four years with a team of 25 across the globe.



Our mission is simple: make exceptional pill cases and provide exceptional customer service. We deliver on this by managing in-house fulfillment at our Washington, DC facility (including custom engraving) and maintaining obsessive attention to detail.



About the Role

We’re hiring a Senior Website & CRO Strategist to take complete ownership of our website, CRO, and landing page operations - as both the strategist who sets the roadmap and the lead builder who ships against it.



This is a true player-coach role. You’ll diagnose where the funnel is leaking, build the test roadmap, and then drive execution forward yourself — hands-on in Replo, Shopify, and Intelligems — while leading a small team (an internal website manager and an external developer) to move faster than you could alone. Strategy and production aren’t separate tracks here. We’re hiring someone who is genuinely excellent at both and wants to keep their hands on the work, not someone who writes briefs and waits.



You’ll run this like your own business unit, working directly with the founder — no layers of management, full autonomy over your domain. If you’ve scaled a DTC CRO program / website team before and want to own the whole thing end to end, this is that role.



5 Core Responsibilities

1. CRO Strategy & Roadmap — Own the testing roadmap end to end: diagnose where the funnel leaks, form prioritized hypotheses, and d
 what we test next and why.

2. Funnel Strategy & Optimization — Design and optimize custom funnels for paid traffic — persona- and offer-specific experiences built to convert Meta spend.

3. Website & Landing Pages Production Lead — Own production of landing pages, PDP updates, and site changes — directing the team and getting hands-on yourself in Replo and Intelligems when the work calls for it.

4. Team Leadership & Developer Management — Lead the website manager and external developer as a hands-on player-coach, keeping the roadmap shipping on time.

5. Cross-Functional Alignment — Keep ads, landing pages,
, and merchandising working as one system alongside the marketing team,
 agency, and customer service.



Why You Should Take This Role

-You’ll be working at a brand that is obsessed with their customers and has built a loyal following. Just read a few of their reviews: 

-You’ll be working at a company that has scaled rapidly in just 4 years and is aggressively investing in growth. Our goal is to make the best pill cases in the world.

-You’ll be working with people who have extreme levels of competitive fire in their bellies — people who will run through walls to make sure the company succeeds.

-You’ll work hand-in-hand with the founder, not through layers of management, with full autonomy to own your domain.

-You’ll be working to make people’s lives easier with products they’ll use every single day. The company was founded to solve a personal problem the founder’s father had with his pill organizers while battling a neurological condition for a decade.



Required Experience & Skills

-4+ years working for a CRO Agency / DTC E-commerce Brand / Growth Agency.

-Experience building a CRO roadmap, planning & executing on A/B tests.

-Experience developing funnels for paid acquisition — building custom experiences for specific personas or specific offers to support paid media spend.

-Experience leading & managing execution, not just recommending strategy. Must be willing to get your hands dirty on production when needed, not just tell others what to do.

-Software experience with Intelligems (A/B testing) and Replo (or similar landing page builders).



Nice-to-Have Experience

-Consumer durables / one-time-purchase product experience (NOT CPG / LTV / subscription).

-Notion fluency (this is our operating system).

-EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System) familiarity.



Compensation Details

-Compensation: $42,000 per year + performance-based bonuses.

-Work Hours: 50 hours per week, flexible scheduling to meet needs of the role with core overlap with US EST business hours.

-Paid Holidays: 10 paid holidays per year.

-PTO: 1 week earned for every 6 months worked at the company.



To Apply

Fill out the application form here: 



This application includes a number of questions in order to ensure we hire an outstanding candidate for this position, so please be advised in advance that it will take time to complete.



Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. Qualified candidates will be contacted for interviews. Applications on OnlineJobs.ph, DMs, and messages sent via
 will not be reviewed.

title: Full Time Dispatcher
description:
About the Role



We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Dispatcher with a positive attitude and excellent communication skills. The ideal candidate will have expertise in load negotiation, scheduling, and route planning, while adhering to DOT and ELD regulations.



Vehicles Being Dispatched



26-Foot Box Trucks (10,000 lb weight capacity) – Dock-high with lift gate

Sprinter Vans / Cargo Vans / Ram ProMaster (High Roof)



About Us



Eveready Express is a well-established leader in the trucking, courier, logistics, and distribution industries, founded in 1984. We pride ourselves on honesty, integrity, and mutual respect.



Key Responsibilities

Dispatching Vehicles



Negotiate rates with drivers while aiming for a minimum 40% margin, and assign vehicles to specific routes and deliveries based on customer orders, schedules, and driver availability.



Communication with Drivers



Maintain constant communication with drivers by providing instructions, updates, and support throughout their routes.



Routing and Scheduling



Plan efficient routes to minimize travel time, fuel costs, and vehicle wear. Adjust schedules as needed to accommodate changes or unexpected events.



Tracking Shipments



Monitor shipments in real time using tracking systems and GPS technology. Address delays or issues as they arise.



Customer Interaction



Serve as the primary point of contact for customers after dispatch, providing delivery updates, addressing inquiries, and resolving concerns or complaints promptly.



Documentation



Maintain accurate records of trucking activities, including driver logs, delivery schedules, and customer communications. Ensure compliance with company policies and regulations (e.g., BOL, POD).



Problem-Solving



Resolve logistical problems or emergencies such as vehicle breakdowns, traffic delays, or adverse weather conditions.



Safety Compliance



Ensure trucks and drivers comply with safety regulations and company policies. Regularly verify driver credentials, vehicle maintenance, and adherence to transportation laws in collaboration with HR.



Team Collaboration



Work closely with Customer Service, Fleet Drivers, Billing, Sales, HR, and Warehouse staff to coordinate operations and improve efficiency.



Continuous Improvement



Identify and suggest improvements to dispatching processes, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency. Offer feedback and innovative solutions to the management team.



Qualifications



• At least 2 years of experience in the U.S. logistics industry, with proven experience in dispatching, logistics coordination, or transportation management.



• Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively interact with drivers, customers, and tea
mbers.



• Excellent organizational and multitasking skills, with strong attention to detail and the ability to prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment.



• Proficiency in dispatching software, GPS systems, and other relevant technology tools.



• Knowledge of transportation regulations, safety procedures, and industry best practices.



• Ability to remain calm under pressure, with a problem-solving mindset and flexibility to adapt to changing circumstances.



• Availability to work irregular hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, to ensure 24/7 coverage.



Hardware & Technical Requirements



• Processor: 2.0 GHz or higher (Intel Core i5/i7 preferred)

• RAM: Minimum 8 GB

• Disk Space: 100 GB of free space

• A second monitor for multitasking

• Backup computer

• Noise-canceling headset

• Internet: Minimum 20  Mbps wired connection for both primary and backup ISPs

• USB sticks are not allowed for backup ISP connections



Perks of the Job



• Competitive weekly salary

• Opportunity to receive HMO benefits

• Opportunities for advancement within the company



To Apply



Please send an
 with the subject line:



“I want to dispatch for Eveready”



to 



Your
 must include:



• A voice recording (via Speakpipe or Vocaroo) explaining why you are a good fit for the role

• A PDF copy of your resume

• A photo of your workstation

• A screenshot of your internet speed test from speedtest.net



Please follow all instructions above. Only applicants who demonstrate genuine interest in the role will be considered.



If selected, you will be invited to a brief
 or Google Meet interview, which will require a video call.



Equal Opportunity Employer



Eveready Express is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate based on race, religion, color, disability, medical condition, genetic information, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, gender identity or expression, sex (including pregnancy), age, veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics.



We are committed to fostering a culture of diversity, equity, and inclusion.

Contracts & Worker Classification

201 Files & Records Management

Onboarding

DOLE & Statutory Compliance
