title: Reliable Remote VA Receptionist (Long Term Contract)
description:
**IMPORTANT: PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING**



We are currently hiring for a long-term Remote Receptionist position. Responsibilities include answering inbound calls, scheduling appointments, de-escalating complaints, and completing administrative tasks in a fast-paced environment. This is a performance-based role where all calls are recorded and regularly audited for quality assurance.



For candidates who may be a stronger fit outside of a call-handling role, we also have a few non-voice positions available, subject to availability and overall fit. If you are interested, please clearly state that you are interested in a non-voice role and submit a brief three-sentence introduction about yourself along with your portfolio or work samples.



Please note our application process: Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we are unable to respond individually to every applicant who is not selected. If you do not receive a response from us within 24 hours with information about the next step in the hiring process, you were not selected to move forward to the next round. We appreciate your interest and thank you for taking the time to apply.



————————————————————



**To apply:** Please copy the questions below, paste them into your reply, and answer each question thoroughly. Please answer based on your own personal experience and provide specific, real examples whenever requested. Incomplete, vague, generic, or copied responses may not be considered.



**(1)** Which city and region in the Philippines are you currently located in? Which backup solutions do you currently have in place for internet or power interruptions?



**(2)** Please submit a link to a screenshot of your internet speed and links to a few samples of your previous work output or portfolio. Please indicate what work you personally completed.



**(3)** Please submit links to two short voice recordings. Recording one should demonstrate booking an appointment from 7:00 PM to 8:00 PM with a total amount of $60. Recording two should demonstrate handling a double charge for a 90-minute massage where the client sees two $90 charges and is requesting a refund.



**(4)** Are you currently employed or engaged in any other work, business, freelance projects, or income-generating activities? If yes, please briefly describe your current commitments and typical weekly availability.



**(5)** Are you able to commit to a fixed 7-day, 6-hour work schedule during Central Standard Time (CST) hours? What is your expected hourly or monthly pay rate and earliest physical start date if hired?



**(6)** Describe three work tasks you have personally completed at least 100 times in a real job. For each task, give a specific example of when you performed the task, explain exactly what you did in your own words, identify the actual tools or systems you used, and describe the final result. Include any specific details, numbers, or challenges you remember from doing the task.



**(7)** If you were hired today, what are three specific work tasks you believe you could fully handle on your own within your first week? For each example, describe the exact task, the tools or software involved, and what successful completion would look like.



**(8)** What is the highest workload you have personally handled in a single day or in a single week? Please describe it using specific, measurable figures and briefly explain the context of that workload.



**(9)** Briefly introduce yourself and describe the qualities, experiences, work habits, or achievements you believe genuinely set you apart from other applicants for this role.

title: Senior Sales Executive
description:
MiM People  ·  Remote  ·  Full-time contractor  ·  Working UK hours (9–5 UK time)  ·  $800/month base + uncapped commission



About MiM People

MiM People helps organisations manage, develop and get the best from their people — through our software platform and the consulting solutions we deliver for our clients. [Tweak this to match how you describe the business — a sentence or two on what you do and who you do it for works best.]

The role

We're looking for a Senior Sales Executive who can open doors at the top and close. You'll sell our software platform and consulting solutions directly to senior directors and C-suite decision-makers — so we need someone credible in the boardroom, sharp on a client's people challenges, and relentless about hitting target.

This is a full-cycle, consultative sales role: you'll own everything from building the pipeline to signing the deal. If you're a natural hunter who's just as comfortable running a director-level discovery call as you are negotiating a contract, this is for you.

What you'll do

• Own the full sales cycle — from first outreach through discovery, demo, proposal, negotiation and close.

• Sell at director and C-suite level — build relationships with senior decision-makers (People/HR directors, operations and finance directors, MDs and founders) and earn their trust.

• Build your own pipeline — prospect and open doors using LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Scalelist, referrals and targeted outreach.

• Sell consultatively — get under the skin of each client's people challenges and position the right mix of software and consulting as the solution, not a one-size-fits-all pitch.

• Hit and beat revenue targets — take ownership of your number and consistently deliver against it.

• Keep the pipeline honest — manage every opportunity in Zoho CRM and forecast accurately.

• Work with marketing and consulting — feed insight back to the wider team and shape proposals that win.

What we're looking for

• At least 10 years in B2B sales, with a proven, evidenced track record of hitting and exceeding revenue targets.

• Experience selling to senior directors and C-suite — you're credible and comfortable in front of senior decision-makers, with the gravitas to hold a boardroom conversation.

• Consultative, solution-led selling — experience selling services or consulting alongside a product, not just transactional deals.

• A genuine hunter — you can build a pipeline from scratch and love opening new doors.

• Strong commercial communication — excellent spoken and written English, and confident, polished presentation and negotiation skills.

• CRM discipline and reliable forecasting — Zoho CRM experience is a plus.

• Ideally, experience selling in HR, people, SaaS or professional services — or into senior HR/operations buyers.

• Self-starting, target-driven and resilient — you bring ideas, take initiative and don't need to be chased.

• Comfortable using AI tools to research accounts, sharpen outreach and work smarter.

The details

• Type: Independent contractor (full-time, 40 hours per week)

• Location: Remote

• Hours: Working UK business hours (9–5 UK time)

• Compensation: $800 per month base salary, plus uncapped commission



How to apply

 

Please include evidence of your sales track record — targets hit, deals closed and the level you've sold at.
